decisions.choice: harsh: strict, exacting
decisions.reason: The word describes someone severe and hard to please, who demands what is owed and more.

decisions.choice: you take up what you did not lay down, and reap what you did not sow: you profit from what others have done
decisions.reason: Both sayings sound like proverbs for someone who gets gain without work of his own. The slave uses them to excuse his fear; the king takes up his words in 19:22.

decisions.choice: for: the reason he kept the money hidden
decisions.reason: "For" explains why he put the money away instead of trading with it.

decisions.choice: take out what you never put in (B); take money you did not put in (R)
alternatives: take up what you did not lay down
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a picture from money, which fits the story; Literal keeps the wording.

decisions.choice: "khắc nghiệt" (L, B); "khó tính" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 25:24.

decisions.choice: "엄한" for austeros at every level; the servant speaks of his master with the honorific ("분이시므로", "가져가시고", "거두십니다")
decisions.reason: Strict and exacting (meaning decision); his fear does not lower his speech level.

decisions.choice: "ጥብቅ" (strict, exacting)
decisions.reason: Matthew's slave calls his master by a different Greek word, "hard", rendered "ጨካኝ" there. Luke's word means strict and exacting, so the Amharic differs here as the Greek does.

source.text: λέγει αὐτῷ· Ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου κρίνω σε, πονηρὲ δοῦλε· ᾔδεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος αὐστηρός εἰμι, αἴρων ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκα καὶ θερίζων ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρα;

records.literal_gloss: He says to him, Out of the mouth of you I will judge you, wicked slave; you knew that I a man harsh am, taking up what not I laid down and reaping what not I sowed?

en.L: He says to him, 'Out of your own mouth I will judge you, wicked slave! You knew that I am a harsh man, taking up what I did not lay down and reaping what I did not sow?
en.B: He answered, 'Your own words condemn you, you wicked servant! So you knew that I am a severe man, taking out what I never put in and harvesting what I never planted?
en.R: The king answered, 'You are an evil servant! I will judge you by what you have just said. You say you knew that I am a hard man. You knew that I take money I did not put in, and gather crops I did not plant.

es.L: Le dice: “Por tu propia boca te juzgaré, esclavo malo. ¿Sabías que yo soy un hombre severo, que tomo lo que no puse y cosecho lo que no sembré?
es.B: Él le respondió: “¡Tus propias palabras te condenan, siervo malvado! ¿Así que sabías que soy un hombre exigente, que saco lo que no deposité y cosecho lo que no sembré?
es.R: El rey le contestó: “¡Eres un siervo malo! Te voy a juzgar por lo que acabas de decir. Dices que sabías que soy un hombre duro. Sabías que me quedo con dinero que no puse y que recojo cosechas que no planté.

fr.L: Il lui dit : “C’est d’après ta bouche que je te jugerai, mauvais esclave ! Tu savais que moi, je suis un homme sévère, prenant ce que je n’ai pas déposé et moissonnant ce que je n’ai pas semé ?
fr.B: Il lui a répondu : “Tes propres paroles te condamnent, mauvais serviteur ! Ainsi, tu savais que je suis un homme exigeant, qui retire ce qu’il n’a jamais placé et récolte ce qu’il n’a jamais planté ?
fr.R: Le roi a répondu : “Tu es un mauvais serviteur ! Je vais te juger d’après ce que tu viens de dire. Tu dis que tu savais que je suis un homme dur. Tu savais que je prends de l’argent que je n’ai pas placé, et que je récolte ce que je n’ai pas planté.

sw.L: Anamwambia, 'Kwa kinywa chako mwenyewe nitakuhukumu, mtumwa mwovu! Ulijua kwamba mimi ni mtu mkali, ninayechukua nisichokiweka na kuvuna nisichokipanda?
sw.B: Akamjibu, 'Maneno yako mwenyewe yanakuhukumu, wewe mtumishi mwovu! Kumbe ulijua kwamba mimi ni mtu mkali, ninayechukua kile ambacho sikuweka na kuvuna kile ambacho sikupanda?
sw.R: Mfalme akamjibu, 'Wewe ni mtumishi mbaya! Nitakuhukumu kwa maneno uliyosema sasa hivi. Unasema ulijua kwamba mimi ni mtu mgumu. Ulijua kwamba ninachukua fedha ambazo sikuziweka, na kukusanya mazao ambayo sikuyapanda.

vi.L: Chủ nói với người ấy: 'Hỡi nô lệ gian ác, ta sẽ xét xử ngươi bởi chính miệng ngươi. Ngươi biết rằng ta là người khắc nghiệt, lấy điều ta không đặt để và gặt điều ta không gieo sao?
vi.B: Chủ đáp: 'Hỡi đầy tớ gian ác kia, chính lời ngươi kết án ngươi! Vậy ra ngươi biết ta là người khắc nghiệt, lấy cái ta không bỏ vào và gặt cái ta không gieo sao?
vi.R: Nhà vua trả lời: 'Ngươi là đầy tớ gian ác! Ta sẽ xét xử ngươi theo chính lời ngươi vừa nói. Ngươi nói ngươi biết ta là người khó tính. Ngươi biết ta lấy tiền ta không bỏ ra, và gặt lúa ta không trồng.

ko.L: 그가 그에게 말한다. '네 입에서 [나온 말로] 내가 너를 심판하겠다, 악한 종아! 내가 두지 않은 것을 가져가고 뿌리지 않은 것을 거두는 엄한 사람인 줄을 네가 알았느냐?
ko.B: 주인이 그에게 대답했다. '이 악한 종아, 네가 한 말로 내가 너를 심판하겠다. 내가 맡기지 않은 것을 찾아가고 심지 않은 것을 거두는 엄한 사람인 줄 네가 알았다는 말이냐?
ko.R: 왕이 대답했다. '너는 악한 종이다! 네가 방금 한 말로 내가 너를 심판하겠다. 너는 내가 엄한 사람이라는 것을 알았다고 했다. 내가 넣지 않은 돈을 가져가고 심지 않은 곡식을 거두는 사람인 줄 알았다고 했다.

pt.L: Ele lhe diz: 'Pela sua própria boca eu vou julgá-lo, escravo mau! Você sabia que eu sou um homem severo, que tiro o que não pus e colho o que não semeei?
pt.B: Ele respondeu: 'As suas próprias palavras condenam você, servo mau! Então você sabia que eu sou um homem exigente, que retiro o que nunca depositei e colho o que nunca plantei?
pt.R: O rei respondeu: 'Você é um servo mau! Vou julgar você pelo que você mesmo acabou de dizer. Você diz que sabia que eu sou um homem duro. Você sabia que eu pego dinheiro que não investi e colho o que não plantei.

am.L: እንዲህ ይለዋል፦ “ከገዛ አፍህ እፈርድብሃለሁ፣ አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ! ያላኖርኩትን የምወስድ፣ ያልዘራሁትንም የማጭድ ጥብቅ ሰው እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቅ ነበርን?
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት፦ “አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፣ የገዛ ቃልህ ይፈርድብሃል! ታዲያ ያላስቀመጥኩትን የማወጣ፣ ያልዘራሁትንም የማጭድ ጥብቅ ሰው እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቅ ነበር?
am.R: ንጉሡም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት፦ “አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ ነህ! አሁን በተናገርከው ቃል እፈርድብሃለሁ። ጥብቅ ሰው እንደ ሆንኩ አውቅ ነበር ትላለህ። ያላስቀመጥኩትን ገንዘብ እንደምወስድ፣ ያልተከልኩትንም ሰብል እንደምሰበስብ ታውቅ ነበር።

ru.L: Говорит ему: “Твоими устами буду судить тебя, злой раб! Ты знал, что я человек суровый, беру, чего не клал, и жну, чего не сеял?
ru.B: Он ответил: “Твои же слова осуждают тебя, злой раб! Значит, ты знал, что я человек жёсткий, забираю то, чего не вкладывал, и собираю урожай там, где не сеял?
ru.R: Царь ответил: “Ты злой раб! Я буду судить тебя по твоим же словам. Ты говоришь, что знал, что я суровый человек. Ты знал, что я беру деньги, которых не вкладывал, и собираю урожай, которого не сажал.

hi.L: वह उससे कहता है, 'हे दुष्ट दास, मैं तुम्हारे ही मुँह से तुम्हारा न्याय करूँगा! तुम जानते थे कि मैं कठोर मनुष्य हूँ, जो मैंने नहीं रखा उसे उठा लेता हूँ और जो मैंने नहीं बोया उसे काटता हूँ?
hi.B: उसने उत्तर दिया, 'अरे दुष्ट दास, तुम्हारी अपनी ही बातें तुम्हें दोषी ठहराती हैं! तो तुम जानते थे कि मैं सख़्त आदमी हूँ, जो मैंने कभी जमा नहीं किया वह निकाल लेता हूँ और जो मैंने कभी नहीं बोया उसकी फ़सल काटता हूँ?
hi.R: राजा ने उत्तर दिया, 'तुम बुरे दास हो! मैं तुम्हारी अभी कही हुई बात से ही तुम्हारा न्याय करूँगा। तुम कहते हो कि तुम जानते थे कि मैं कठोर आदमी हूँ। तुम जानते थे कि जो पैसा मैंने नहीं लगाया, वह मैं ले लेता हूँ, और जो फ़सल मैंने नहीं बोई, उसे इकट्ठा करता हूँ।

uk.L: Каже йому: “Твоїми устами суджу тебе, лукавий рабе! Ти знав, що я людина сувора, беру, чого не клав, і жну, чого не сіяв?
uk.B: Він відповів: “Твої ж слова тебе засуджують, лукавий рабе! То ти знав, що я чоловік суворий, що забираю те, чого не вкладав, і жну те, чого не сіяв?
uk.R: Цар відповів: “Ти поганий слуга! Я суджу тебе за тим, що ти сам щойно сказав. Ти кажеш, що знав, що я жорстка людина. Ти знав, що я забираю гроші, яких не вкладав, і збираю врожай там, де не сіяв.

ja.L: [主人は]彼に言う。『おまえの口から[出た言葉で]、わたしはおまえを裁く、悪い奴隷よ。わたしが、置かなかったものを取り上げ、蒔かなかったものを刈り取る厳しい人間だと、おまえは知っていたのか？
ja.B: 主人は言った。『悪いしもべよ、おまえ自身の言葉で、おまえを裁こう。わたしが、預けもしないものを引き出し、蒔きもしないものを刈り取る厳しい人間だと、知っていたというのか？
ja.R: 王は答えた。『おまえは悪いしもべだ！おまえが今言った言葉で、おまえを裁こう。おまえは、わたしが厳しい人間だと知っていたと言う。わたしが自分で入れていないお金を取り、自分で植えていない作物を集める者だと、知っていたと言うのだな。

decisions.choice: out of your mouth I will judge you: your own words will be the grounds for my judgment
alternatives: I will judge you for speaking
decisions.reason: The mouth stands for what a person says. The slave's own description of the master shows that he should have acted.

decisions.choice: you knew ...? : a question that takes up the slave's words, not an admission
alternatives: a statement: you knew that I am harsh
decisions.reason: The king repeats the slave's claim to show where it leads (19:23), without agreeing that it is true. The sentence can be read as a question or as a statement; the sense is much the same.

decisions.choice: wicked: evil, worthless
decisions.reason: The word is the usual word for evil. His failure to serve shows what he is.

decisions.choice: he says: the present tense brings the scene close
decisions.reason: Luke uses a present tense here for a past event, as storytellers do; the renderings use the past at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: the charge first, then the servant's own words
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long question into short statements.

decisions.choice: the king's words continue to the end of 19:23
decisions.reason: The single quotation mark closes at the end of 19:23.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable (style guide); Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal (Le dice); past at Balanced and Readable (le respondió, le contestó)
decisions.reason: Luke tells the king's answer in the present (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable tell it in the past, as Spanish narrative does.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (Anamwambia); past at Balanced and Readable (Akamjibu)
decisions.reason: Luke tells the king's answer in the present (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the narrative past.

decisions.choice: "Chủ nói" without "đã" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the historic present (meaning decision) by leaving out the past marker, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "말한다" (L) for the historic present
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 7:40 and 13:8; Balanced and Readable use the past.

decisions.choice: "심판하다" for krino at every level; "악한 종" at every level
decisions.reason: The king's words are a verdict on the servant, so the same verb is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: "言う" (L, historic present); "言った", "答えた" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the present tense Luke uses here (m4); Balanced and Readable narrate in the past.

source.text: καὶ διὰ τί οὐκ ἔδωκάς μου τὸ ἀργύριον ἐπὶ τράπεζαν;

records.literal_gloss: And why not did you give my the money on a table?

en.L: And why did you not put my money on a [banker's] table?
en.B: Then why did you not put my money in the bank?
en.R: Then why did you not at least put my money in the bank?

es.L: ¿Y por qué no pusiste mi dinero sobre [la] mesa [de un cambista]?
es.B: Entonces, ¿por qué no pusiste mi dinero en el banco?
es.R: Entonces, ¿por qué no pusiste por lo menos mi dinero en el banco?

fr.L: Et pourquoi n’as-tu pas mis mon argent sur une table [de banquier] ?
fr.B: Alors pourquoi n’as-tu pas mis mon argent à la banque ?
fr.R: Alors pourquoi n’as-tu pas au moins mis mon argent à la banque ?

sw.L: Basi kwa nini hukuweka fedha zangu mezani [pa mbadilishaji fedha]?
sw.B: Basi kwa nini hukuweka fedha zangu benki?
sw.R: Basi kwa nini angalau hukuweka fedha zangu benki?

vi.L: Vậy sao ngươi không đem tiền của ta đặt trên bàn [người đổi bạc]?
vi.B: Thế thì sao ngươi không gửi tiền của ta cho người đổi bạc?
vi.R: Thế thì sao ít ra ngươi không gửi tiền của ta vào ngân hàng?

ko.L: 그런데 어째서 너는 내 돈을 [환전상의] 탁자에 맡기지 않았느냐?
ko.B: 그렇다면 왜 내 돈을 은행에 맡기지 않았느냐?
ko.R: 그렇다면 왜 내 돈을 은행에라도 맡기지 않았느냐?

pt.L: E por que você não pôs o meu dinheiro numa mesa [de banqueiro]?
pt.B: Então por que você não depositou o meu dinheiro no banco?
pt.R: Então por que você não colocou pelo menos o meu dinheiro no banco?

am.L: ታዲያ ገንዘቤን ለምን በ[ገንዘብ ለዋጮች] ገበታ ላይ አላኖርከውም?
am.B: ታዲያ ገንዘቤን ለምን በባንክ አላስቀመጥከውም?
am.R: ታዲያ ቢያንስ ገንዘቤን ለምን በባንክ አላስቀመጥከውም?

ru.L: И почему ты не отдал моё серебро на стол менял?
ru.B: Почему же ты не отдал мои деньги менялам?
ru.R: Почему же ты хотя бы не положил мои деньги в банк?

hi.L: तो तुमने मेरा धन [साहूकार की] मेज़ पर क्यों नहीं रखा?
hi.B: तो फिर तुमने मेरा पैसा साहूकार के पास जमा क्यों नहीं किया?
hi.R: तो तुमने कम से कम मेरा पैसा बैंक में क्यों नहीं जमा किया?

uk.L: І чому ти не дав мого срібла на [міняльний] стіл?
uk.B: То чому ти не поклав моїх грошей у банк?
uk.R: То чому ти хоча б не поклав моїх грошей у банк?

ja.L: それなら、なぜ、わたしのお金を[両替人の]台に置かなかったのか？
ja.B: それなら、なぜわたしのお金を銀行に預けなかったのか？
ja.R: それなら、なぜせめて、わたしのお金を銀行に預けておかなかったのか？

decisions.choice: a table: the table of a money-changer or banker
decisions.reason: Bankers did business at tables in public places, changing money and taking deposits on which they paid interest (compare 19:45; Matthew 21:12).

decisions.choice: why did you not ...: even the least effort would have done
alternatives: the bank was the best choice
decisions.reason: If he feared his master, the slave could have done the safest and easiest thing. He did nothing at all.

decisions.choice: at least
decisions.reason: Readable brings out that the bank was the smallest thing he could have done (m2).

decisions.choice: "bàn [người đổi bạc]" (L); "người đổi bạc" (B); "ngân hàng" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 25:27: the table is a money-changer's (meaning decision); Readable uses the modern word.

decisions.choice: "[환전상의] 탁자" (L); "은행" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The table of a money-changer or banker (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable use the modern word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "на стол менял" (L); "менялам" (B); "в банк" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 25:27: the money changers at their tables also took deposits; Readable uses the modern word.
As in Matthew 25:27: the money-changer's table (meaning decision m1) was a moneylender's business, which Balanced calls by its Hindi name; Readable uses the modern word.

decisions.choice: "на [міняльний] стіл" (L); "у банк" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of the table of a money-changer, who also took deposits; Literal keeps the table, Balanced and Readable give the modern equivalent, as the English does.

source.text: κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν σὺν τόκῳ ἂν αὐτὸ ἔπραξα.

records.literal_gloss: And I having come with interest would it have collected.

en.L: And I, having come, would have collected it with interest.'
en.B: Then when I came back, I would have collected it with interest.'
en.R: Then when I came home, I could have collected it with the interest it had earned.'

es.L: Y yo, al venir, lo habría cobrado con intereses”.
es.B: Así, al volver, lo habría cobrado con los intereses”.
es.R: Así, cuando yo volviera a casa, habría podido cobrarlo con los intereses que hubiera ganado”.

fr.L: Et moi, à mon retour, je l’aurais récupéré avec un intérêt.”
fr.B: À mon retour, je l’aurais retiré avec les intérêts.”
fr.R: Alors, en rentrant chez moi, j’aurais pu le reprendre avec les intérêts qu’il aurait rapportés.”

sw.L: Nami nikiisha kuja, ningalizichukua pamoja na riba.'
sw.B: Ndipo nikirudi, ningezichukua pamoja na riba.'
sw.R: Hivyo nikirudi nyumbani, ningeweza kuzichukua pamoja na riba iliyopatikana.'

vi.L: Và khi ta đến, ta đã thu nó về cùng với tiền lời.'
vi.B: Như vậy khi về, ta đã thu lại được cả vốn lẫn lời.'
vi.R: Như thế khi ta về, ta đã có thể lấy lại tiền của ta cùng với tiền lời.'

ko.L: 그랬으면 내가 와서 그것을 이자와 함께 받았을 것이다.'
ko.B: 그랬으면 내가 돌아와서 그 돈을 이자와 함께 찾았을 것이다.'
ko.R: 그랬으면 내가 집에 돌아왔을 때 그 돈에 붙은 이자까지 받을 수 있었을 것이다.'

pt.L: E eu, ao vir, o teria cobrado com juros.'
pt.B: Assim, quando eu voltasse, eu o teria recebido com juros.'
pt.R: Assim, quando eu voltasse para casa, poderia receber o dinheiro de volta com os juros que ele tivesse rendido.'

am.L: እኔም መጥቼ ከወለድ ጋር እወስደው ነበር።”
am.B: እኔም ስመለስ ከወለዱ ጋር እወስደው ነበር።”
am.R: እኔም ወደ ቤቴ ስመለስ ካስገኘው ወለድ ጋር ልወስደው እችል ነበር።”

ru.L: И я, придя, получил бы его с процентами.”
ru.B: Тогда, вернувшись, я получил бы его с процентами.”
ru.R: Тогда, вернувшись домой, я мог бы получить их обратно вместе с процентами, которые они заработали.”

hi.L: और मैं आकर उसे ब्याज समेत वसूल कर लेता।'
hi.B: तब लौटने पर मैं उसे ब्याज समेत ले लेता।'
hi.R: तब घर लौटकर मैं उसे उस पर बने ब्याज के साथ वापस ले सकता था।'

uk.L: І я, прийшовши, стягнув би його з відсотками.”
uk.B: Тоді, повернувшись, я отримав би їх із відсотками.”
uk.R: Тоді, коли я повернувся б додому, я забрав би їх разом із відсотками, які вони заробили.”

ja.L: そうすれば、わたしが来て、それを利息と共に取り立てたであろうに。』
ja.B: そうすれば、帰って来たときに、それを利息と一緒に受け取れたのに。』
ja.R: そうすれば、わたしが帰って来たときに、利息のついたお金を受け取ることができたのだ。』

decisions.choice: interest: payment for the use of deposited money
decisions.reason: The law forbade Israelites to charge interest on loans to a poor fellow Israelite (Exodus 22:25; Deuteronomy 23:19-20), but bankers paid interest on deposits, as the story assumes.

decisions.choice: would have collected: what would have happened if he had banked it
alternatives: what the king will now do
decisions.reason: The particle with the past tense describes what did not happen.

source.text: καὶ τοῖς παρεστῶσιν εἶπεν· Ἄρατε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ τὴν μνᾶν καὶ δότε τῷ τὰς δέκα μνᾶς ἔχοντι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, ἔχει δέκα μνᾶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι παντὶ τῷ ἔχοντι δοθήσεται, ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: And to the [ones] standing by he said, Take from him the mina and give [it] to the [one] the ten minas having \v 25 — and they said to him, Lord, he has ten minas — \v 26 I say to you that to everyone having it will be given, but from the [one] not having even what he has will be taken away.

en.L: And he said to those standing by, 'Take the mina from him and give [it] to the one who has the ten minas.' \v 25 And they said to him, 'Master, he has ten minas!' \v 26 'I tell you that to everyone who has, [more] will be given; but from the one who does not have, even what {{gender:they have|he has}} will be taken away.
en.B: Then he said to those standing there, 'Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten.' \v 25 'Master,' they said, 'he has ten minas already!' \v 26 'I tell you, everyone who has will be given more. But the one who has nothing will lose even what {{gender:they have|he has}}.
en.R: Then the king said to the men standing near him, 'Take the mina away from this servant. Give it to the servant who has ten minas.' \v 25 They said to him, 'But master, he already has ten minas!' \v 26 The king answered, 'I tell you, people who have something will be given more. But people who have nothing will lose even the little they have.

es.L: Y dijo a los que estaban presentes: “{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} la mina y {{plural_you:dénsela|dádsela}} al que tiene las diez minas”. \v 25 Y le dijeron: “Señor, ¡tiene diez minas!”. \v 26 “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que a todo el que tiene, se le dará [más]; pero al que no tiene, aun lo que tiene se le quitará.
es.B: Entonces dijo a los que estaban allí: “{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} la mina y {{plural_you:dénsela|dádsela}} al que tiene diez”. \v 25 “Señor —le dijeron—, ¡si ya tiene diez minas!”. \v 26 “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que a todo el que tiene se le dará más. Pero al que no tiene nada se le quitará hasta lo que tiene.
es.R: Luego el rey dijo a los hombres que estaban a su lado: “{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} la mina a este siervo. {{plural_you:Dénsela|Dádsela}} al siervo que tiene diez minas”. \v 25 Ellos le dijeron: “Pero, señor, ¡él ya tiene diez minas!”. \v 26 El rey respondió: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que a quien tiene algo se le dará más. Pero a quien no tiene nada se le quitará hasta lo poco que tiene.

fr.L: Et il a dit à ceux qui se tenaient là : “Enlevez-lui la mine et donnez[-la] à celui qui a les dix mines.” \v 25 Et ils lui ont dit : “Maître, il a dix mines !” \v 26 “Je vous dis qu’à quiconque a, [davantage] sera donné ; mais à celui qui n’a pas, même ce qu’il a sera enlevé.
fr.B: Puis il a dit à ceux qui étaient là : “Prenez-lui la mine et donnez-la à celui qui en a dix.” \v 25 “Maître, lui ont-ils dit, il a déjà dix mines !” \v 26 “Je vous le dis : à celui qui a, on donnera davantage. Mais celui qui n’a rien perdra même ce qu’il a.
fr.R: Ensuite, le roi a dit aux hommes qui se tenaient près de lui : “Enlevez la mine à ce serviteur. Donnez-la au serviteur qui a dix mines.” \v 25 Ils lui ont dit : “Mais maître, il a déjà dix mines !” \v 26 Le roi a répondu : “Je vous le dis : les gens qui ont quelque chose recevront davantage. Mais les gens qui n’ont rien perdront même le peu qu’ils ont.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia wale waliosimama karibu, 'Mnyang'anyeni ile mina, mkampe yule mwenye mina kumi.' \v 25 Nao wakamwambia, 'Bwana, ana mina kumi!' \v 26 'Nawaambia kwamba kila aliye na kitu atapewa [zaidi], lakini asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho kitaondolewa kwake.
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamesimama pale, 'Mnyang'anyeni mina hiyo, mkampe yule mwenye mina kumi.' \v 25 Wakamwambia, 'Bwana, tayari ana mina kumi!' \v 26 'Nawaambia, kila aliye na kitu ataongezewa. Lakini asiye na kitu atanyang'anywa hata kile alicho nacho.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme akawaambia watu waliosimama karibu naye, 'Mnyang'anyeni mtumishi huyu mina hiyo. Mpeni mtumishi mwenye mina kumi.' \v 25 Wakamwambia, 'Lakini bwana, tayari ana mina kumi!' \v 26 Mfalme akajibu, 'Nawaambia, watu walio na kitu wataongezewa zaidi. Lakini watu wasio na kitu watanyang'anywa hata kile kidogo walicho nacho.

vi.L: Và ông nói với những người đứng gần: 'Hãy lấy mi-na khỏi nó và đưa cho người có mười mi-na.' \v 25 Và họ nói với ông: 'Thưa chủ, người ấy có mười mi-na [rồi]!' \v 26 'Ta nói với các ngươi rằng ai có, sẽ được cho [thêm]; còn ai không có, thì ngay cả điều người ấy có cũng sẽ bị lấy đi.
vi.B: Rồi ông bảo những người đứng đó: 'Hãy lấy {{units:nén bạc|mi-na}} của nó mà đưa cho người có {{units:mười nén|mười mi-na}}.' \v 25 Họ thưa: 'Thưa chủ, người ấy đã có {{units:mười nén|mười mi-na}} rồi!' \v 26 'Ta nói cho các ngươi biết, ai đã có sẽ được cho thêm. Còn ai không có gì, thì ngay cả cái mình đang có cũng sẽ bị lấy mất.
vi.R: Rồi nhà vua bảo những người đứng gần mình: 'Hãy lấy {{units:nén bạc|mi-na}} khỏi người đầy tớ này. Đưa nó cho người đầy tớ có {{units:mười nén|mười mi-na}}.' \v 25 Họ nói với vua: 'Nhưng thưa chủ, người ấy đã có {{units:mười nén|mười mi-na}} rồi!' \v 26 Nhà vua trả lời: 'Ta nói cho các ngươi biết, ai đã có thì sẽ được cho thêm. Còn ai không có gì, thì ngay cả một chút ít họ đang có cũng sẽ bị lấy đi.

ko.L: 그리고 곁에 서 있는 사람들에게 그가 말했다. '그에게서 그 므나를 빼앗아 열 므나를 가진 사람에게 주어라.' \v 25 그러자 그들이 그에게 말했다. '주인님, 그는 열 므나를 가지고 있습니다.' \v 26 '내가 너희에게 말한다. 가진 모든 사람에게는 [더] 주어질 것이고, 가지지 못한 사람에게서는 자기가 가진 것까지 빼앗길 것이다.
ko.B: 그리고 그는 곁에 서 있는 사람들에게 말했다. '그에게서 그 한 므나를 빼앗아 열 므나를 가진 종에게 주어라.' \v 25 그들이 말했다. '주인님, 그 사람은 이미 열 므나나 가지고 있습니다.' \v 26 '내가 너희에게 말한다. 가진 사람은 누구나 더 받을 것이고, 가진 것이 없는 사람은 자기가 가진 것마저 빼앗길 것이다.
ko.R: 그리고 왕이 곁에 서 있던 사람들에게 말했다. '이 종에게서 한 므나를 빼앗아라. 그리고 열 므나를 가진 종에게 주어라.' \v 25 그들이 왕에게 말했다. '하지만 주인님, 그 종은 벌써 열 므나를 가지고 있습니다!' \v 26 왕이 대답했다. '내가 너희에게 말한다. 무언가를 가진 사람은 더 받게 될 것이다. 그러나 아무것도 없는 사람은 조금 가진 것마저 빼앗길 것이다.

pt.L: E ele disse aos que estavam ali presentes: 'Tirem dele a mina e [a] deem ao que tem as dez minas.' \v 25 E eles lhe disseram: 'Senhor, ele tem dez minas!' \v 26 'Eu lhes digo que a todo aquele que tem [mais] será dado; mas daquele que não tem, até o que tem será tirado.
pt.B: Então ele disse aos que estavam ali: 'Tirem dele a mina e deem ao que tem dez.' \v 25 'Senhor', disseram eles, 'ele já tem dez minas!' \v 26 'Eu lhes digo: a quem tem, mais será dado. Mas quem não tem perderá até o que tem.
pt.R: Então o rei disse aos homens que estavam perto dele: 'Tirem a mina deste servo. Deem a mina ao servo que tem dez minas.' \v 25 Eles disseram ao rei: 'Mas, senhor, ele já tem dez minas!' \v 26 O rei respondeu: 'Eu digo a vocês: as pessoas que têm alguma coisa vão receber mais. Mas as pessoas que não têm nada vão perder até o pouco que têm.

am.L: በዚያ ቆመው የነበሩትንም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ “ምናኑን ከእርሱ ውሰዱ፤ አሥሩ ምናን ላለውም ስጡት።” \v 25 እነርሱም፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ አሥር ምናን አለው እኮ!” አሉት። \v 26 “እላችኋለሁ፣ ላለው ሁሉ [ተጨማሪ] ይሰጠዋል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።
am.B: ከዚያም በዚያ ቆመው የነበሩትን፦ “ምናኑን ከእርሱ ወስዳችሁ አሥር ላለው ስጡት።” አላቸው። \v 25 “ጌታችን ሆይ፣” አሉት፣ “እርሱ እኮ ቀድሞውንም አሥር ምናን አለው!” \v 26 “እላችኋለሁ፣ ላለው ሁሉ ይጨመርለታል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።
am.R: ከዚያም ንጉሡ በአጠገቡ ቆመው የነበሩትን ሰዎች እንዲህ አላቸው፦ “ምናኑን ከዚህ ባሪያ ውሰዱ። አሥር ምናን ላለው ባሪያ ስጡት።” \v 25 እነርሱም፦ “ጌታችን፣ እርሱ እኮ አሥር ምናን አለው!” አሉት። \v 26 ንጉሡም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ፦ “እላችኋለሁ፣ አንድ ነገር ላላቸው ሰዎች ተጨማሪ ይሰጣቸዋል። ምንም የሌላቸው ግን ያላቸው ትንሽ ነገር እንኳ ይወሰድባቸዋል።

ru.L: И стоявшим рядом он сказал: “Возьмите у него мину и отдайте тому, у кого десять мин.” \v 25 И сказали ему: “Господин, у него десять мин!” \v 26 “Говорю вам, что всякому имеющему будет дано, а у неимеющего отнимется и то, что имеет.
ru.B: Тогда он сказал стоявшим рядом: “Возьмите у него мину и отдайте тому, у кого десять.” \v 25 “Господин”, — сказали они, — “у него и так десять мин!” \v 26 “Говорю вам: каждому, у кого есть, дано будет ещё. А у того, у кого нет, отнимут даже то, что у него есть.
ru.R: Потом царь сказал людям, которые стояли рядом с ним: “Заберите мину у этого раба. Отдайте её рабу, у которого десять мин.” \v 25 Они сказали ему: “Но господин, у него уже есть десять мин!” \v 26 Царь ответил: “Говорю вам: тем, у кого что-то есть, будет дано ещё. А те, у кого ничего нет, потеряют даже то немногое, что у них есть.

hi.L: और जो पास खड़े थे, उनसे उसने कहा, 'वह मीना उससे ले लो और उसे दे दो जिसके पास दस मीना हैं।' \v 25 उन्होंने उससे कहा, 'हे स्वामी, उसके पास तो दस मीना हैं!' \v 26 'मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ कि हर एक जिसके पास है, उसे [और] दिया जाएगा; पर जिसके पास नहीं है, उससे वह भी जो उसके पास है ले लिया जाएगा।
hi.B: फिर उसने पास खड़े लोगों से कहा, 'वह मीना उससे ले लो और उसे दे दो जिसके पास दस हैं।' \v 25 'हे स्वामी,' उन्होंने कहा, 'उसके पास तो पहले से दस मीना हैं!' \v 26 'मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, जिसके पास है, उसे और दिया जाएगा। पर जिसके पास कुछ नहीं है, उससे वह भी ले लिया जाएगा जो उसके पास है।
hi.R: फिर राजा ने पास खड़े लोगों से कहा, 'इस दास से वह मीना ले लो। उसे उस दास को दे दो जिसके पास दस मीना हैं।' \v 25 उन्होंने उससे कहा, 'पर हे स्वामी, उसके पास तो पहले से दस मीना हैं!' \v 26 राजा ने उत्तर दिया, 'मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, जिन लोगों के पास कुछ है, उन्हें और दिया जाएगा। पर जिनके पास कुछ नहीं है, उनसे वह थोड़ा भी ले लिया जाएगा जो उनके पास है।

uk.L: І тим, що стояли поруч, сказав: “Заберіть у нього міну і дайте [її] тому, хто має десять мін.” \v 25 І сказали йому: “Пане, він має десять мін!” \v 26 “Кажу вам, що кожному, хто має, буде дано, а від того, хто не має, буде забране й те, що має.
uk.B: Тоді він сказав тим, хто стояв поруч: “Заберіть у нього міну й віддайте тому, хто має десять.” \v 25 “Пане”, — сказали вони, — “у нього ж уже є десять мін!” \v 26 “Кажу вам: кожному, хто має, буде дано більше. А в того, хто не має, забереться навіть те, що він має.
uk.R: Тоді цар сказав людям, які стояли біля нього: “Заберіть у цього слуги міну. Віддайте її слузі, у якого десять мін.” \v 25 Вони сказали йому: “Але, пане, у нього вже є десять мін!” \v 26 Цар відповів: “Кажу вам: людям, які щось мають, дадуть ще більше. А в людей, які нічого не мають, заберуть навіть те мале, що в них є.

ja.L: そして、そばに立っている者たちに言った。『その者から一ムナを取り上げて、十ムナを持っている者に与えよ。』\v 25 すると彼らは彼に言った。『ご主人さま、その人は十ムナを持っています。』\v 26 『おまえたちに言う。持っている者はだれでも[さらに]与えられ、持っていない者からは、持っているものまでも取り上げられる。
ja.B: そして、そばに立っている者たちに言った。『その者から{{units:百日分の賃金|一ムナ}}を取り上げて、{{units:千日分の賃金|十ムナ}}を持っている者に与えよ。』\v 25 『ご主人さま』と彼らは言った。『あの者はもう{{units:千日分の賃金|十ムナ}}も持っています。』\v 26 『おまえたちに言っておく。だれでも持っている者は、さらに与えられる。しかし、持っていない者は、持っているものまでも取り上げられる。
ja.R: それから王は、そばに立っていた者たちに言った。『このしもべから{{units:百日分の賃金|一ムナ}}を取り上げなさい。そして、{{units:千日分の賃金|十ムナ}}持っているしもべに与えなさい。』\v 25 その者たちは王に言った。『でもご主人さま、あのしもべはもう{{units:千日分の賃金|十ムナ}}も持っています！』\v 26 王は答えた。『おまえたちに言っておく。何かを持っている人は、もっと与えられる。でも、何も持っていない人は、少し持っているものまで取り上げられてしまう。

decisions.choice: 19:25, the bystanders' protest: included, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: 19:25 left out, as in a few manuscripts
decisions.reason: Almost all manuscripts have the verse. A few, among them Codex Bezae, leave it out, perhaps because it interrupts the king's words. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: they said ...; I tell you: the bystanders interrupt, and the king answers them
alternatives: 19:26 is Jesus speaking to his hearers, outside the story
decisions.reason: "I tell you" could be Jesus stepping out of the parable, as in 18:8, 14. But 19:27 goes on with the king's words ("these enemies of mine"), so 19:26 is best read as the king's reply to the protest.

decisions.choice: to everyone who has, more will be given: those who use what God gives receive more; those who do not, lose it
decisions.reason: Jesus said the same about hearing his word (8:18). What a person "has" is what he has made good use of. The slave who did nothing loses even the mina.

decisions.choice: those standing by: attendants of the king
decisions.reason: Those standing by are the king's servants at his court, who carry out his orders.

decisions.choice: will be given; will be taken away: by the king, in the story
decisions.reason: The passives describe what the king does; in the lesson, what God does.

decisions.choice: Master
decisions.reason: As in 19:16. In the story the word is the title a slave gives the man who owns him; "Lord" would make him sound like God.

decisions.choice: mina (every level)
decisions.reason: The amount is explained once, in Readable at 19:13 and in the meaning decision there. Repeating a modern sum each time the servants speak would make the dialogue hard to follow, so every level keeps the unit's own name. "Pound", the older rendering, now suggests British money.

decisions.choice: {{gender:they have|he has}} (L, B); the little they have (R)
decisions.reason: The saying is about anyone; Greek speaks of such a person with a masculine form. Readable uses plural words for people, which need no setting.

decisions.choice: The king answered
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker of 19:26 (m2).

decisions.choice: the king's words in 19:26 open a quotation that continues to the end of 19:27
decisions.reason: 19:27 goes on with what the king says.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on the commands and on "{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo"
decisions.reason: The king speaks to the attendants standing by (meaning decision m4), so every "you" is plural and takes the ustedes / vosotros setting. English has no such choice.

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "they have|he has" for the one who has nothing. Spanish "lo que tiene" has no pronoun that differs between an inclusive and a traditional wording, so no setting applies.

decisions.choice: celui qui n’a pas (rien) ... ce qu’il a (L, B), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender setting on the pronoun, as the English "they have / he has"
decisions.reason: As the style guide says, "celui qui" already means anyone in French, and the "il" that refers back to it is ordinary generic French, so French needs no setting where the English needs one. Readable uses plural words for people, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "they have|he has" for the one who has nothing. Swahili "alicho nacho" and "kwake" already mean he or she, so no setting applies.

decisions.choice: "người ấy", "mình", "họ" with no gender span
decisions.reason: These Vietnamese words already include men and women, so the English gender setting has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: "nó" for the third servant, spoken of to the attendants
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 25:28: the king speaks of the servant he has condemned with the plain word for an inferior.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to his attendants in 해라체; they answer him in 합쇼체 with "주인님"
decisions.reason: As the servants speak to him in 19:16-21.

decisions.choice: "자기가 가진 것" with no gender span, where the English has one (L, B)
decisions.reason: Korean says "자기" for a man or a woman alike, so there are not two wordings to choose between.
As the English Literal; the Greek leaves "more" to be understood.

decisions.choice: todo aquele que tem ... o que tem (L); quem tem ... o que tem (B), with no gender setting
alternatives: {{gender:o que essa pessoa tem|o que ele tem}}
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "they have" and "he has". Portuguese "todo aquele que" and "quem" already mean anyone, and the verb "tem" needs no pronoun, so no setting is needed (style §7).

decisions.choice: "ጌታችን" (our lord, B, R), for several speakers
decisions.reason: In 19:25 the bystanders speak together, so Balanced and Readable say "our lord" where one slave says "my lord".

decisions.choice: "ያለው" (what he has) with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as the English has ("they have" / "he has")
decisions.reason: In Amharic the third person singular after "ላለው ሁሉ" (to everyone who has) already speaks of anyone, man or woman, so there is nothing for the setting to change (as in Matthew 25:29).

decisions.choice: no gender span: "что имеет" (L); "у него есть" (B)
decisions.reason: The English has a span on "they have|he has". Literal needs no pronoun, and after "каждый" the Russian masculine is the ordinary way to speak of anyone, as in Matthew 25:29.

decisions.choice: no gender span; "जो उसके पास है"
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: "उसके पास" is the same for a man or a woman, so the saying already covers anyone and there is nothing for the setting to change; Readable uses plural words for people, as the English does. Worded as in Matthew 25:29.

decisions.choice: "те, що має" (L), "те, що він має" (B), with no gender span where the English has {{gender:they have|he has}}
decisions.reason: Literal needs no pronoun at all, and in Balanced "він" refers back to "той, хто", which Ukrainian already uses for anyone; Readable speaks of "люди", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "持っているもの" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a gender span for "they have / he has". Japanese leaves the pronoun out and is already inclusive.

source.text: πλὴν τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου τούτους τοὺς μὴ θελήσαντάς με βασιλεῦσαι ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἀγάγετε ὧδε καὶ κατασφάξατε αὐτοὺς ἔμπροσθέν μου.

records.literal_gloss: But the enemies of me these, the [ones] not having wanted me to reign over them, bring here and slaughter them before me.

en.L: But these enemies of mine, who did not want me to reign over them, bring here and slay them before me.'"
en.B: As for these enemies of mine who did not want me as their king, bring them here and execute them in my presence.'"
en.R: And bring here those enemies of mine who did not want me to be their king. Kill them right here in front of me!'"

es.L: Pero a estos enemigos míos, los que no quisieron que yo reinara sobre ellos, {{plural_you:tráiganlos|traedlos}} acá y {{plural_you:degüéllenlos|degolladlos}} delante de mí”».
es.B: Y en cuanto a estos enemigos míos que no me querían por rey, {{plural_you:tráiganlos|traedlos}} aquí y {{plural_you:ejecútenlos|ejecutadlos}} en mi presencia”».
es.R: Y {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} aquí a esos enemigos míos que no querían que yo fuera su rey. ¡{{plural_you:Mátenlos|Matadlos}} aquí mismo, delante de mí!”».

fr.L: Mais ces ennemis, les miens, qui n’ont pas voulu que je règne sur eux, amenez-les ici et égorgez-les devant moi.” »
fr.B: Quant à mes ennemis, ceux qui ne voulaient pas de moi pour roi, amenez-les ici et exécutez-les en ma présence.” »
fr.R: Et ces ennemis qui ne voulaient pas que je sois leur roi, amenez-les ici. Tuez-les ici même, devant moi !” »

sw.L: Lakini adui zangu hawa, wale wasiotaka niwatawale, waleteni hapa mkawachinje mbele yangu.'"
sw.B: Na kuhusu adui zangu hawa ambao hawakutaka niwe mfalme wao, waleteni hapa, mkawaue mbele yangu.'"
sw.R: Tena waleteni hapa wale adui zangu ambao hawakutaka niwe mfalme wao. Waueni hapa hapa mbele yangu!'"

vi.L: Còn những kẻ thù của ta, là những kẻ không muốn ta làm vua cai trị chúng, hãy đem chúng đến đây và giết chúng trước mặt ta.'"
vi.B: Còn những kẻ thù của ta, những kẻ không muốn ta làm vua, hãy dẫn chúng đến đây và xử tử chúng trước mặt ta.'"
vi.R: Còn những kẻ thù của ta, là những kẻ không muốn ta làm vua của họ, hãy đem chúng đến đây. Hãy giết chúng ngay trước mặt ta!'"

ko.L: 그러나 내가 자기들 위에 왕이 되는 것을 원하지 않은 내 원수들, 이 사람들을 이리로 끌고 와서 내 앞에서 쳐 죽여라.'"
ko.B: 그리고 내가 자기들의 왕이 되는 것을 원하지 않던 내 원수들은 이리로 끌어다가 내 앞에서 처형하여라.'"
ko.R: 그리고 내가 자기들의 왕이 되는 것을 싫어한 내 원수들을 이리로 끌고 오너라. 그리고 바로 여기 내 앞에서 그들을 죽여라!'"

pt.L: Mas esses inimigos meus, os que não quiseram que eu reinasse sobre eles, tragam[-nos] aqui e matem-nos diante de mim.'"
pt.B: Quanto a esses meus inimigos, que não me quiseram como rei, tragam-nos aqui e executem-nos na minha presença.'"
pt.R: E tragam aqui aqueles meus inimigos que não queriam que eu fosse o rei deles. Matem todos eles aqui mesmo, na minha frente!'"

am.L: ነገር ግን በእነርሱ ላይ እንድነግሥ ያልፈለጉትን እነዚህን ጠላቶቼን ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው፤ በፊቴም አርዱአቸው።”»
am.B: በእነርሱ ላይ ንጉሥ እንድሆን ያልፈለጉትን እነዚህን ጠላቶቼን ደግሞ ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው፤ በፊቴም ግደሏቸው።”»
am.R: ንጉሣቸው እንድሆን ያልፈለጉትን እነዚያን ጠላቶቼንም ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው። እዚሁ በፊቴ ግደሏቸው!”»

ru.L: А этих моих врагов, которые не хотели, чтобы я царствовал над ними, приведите сюда и перебейте передо мной.”»
ru.B: А этих моих врагов, которые не хотели, чтобы я был их царём, приведите сюда и казните у меня на глазах.”»
ru.R: И приведите сюда моих врагов, которые не хотели, чтобы я был их царём. Убейте их прямо здесь, передо мной!”»

hi.L: पर मेरे इन शत्रुओं को, जो नहीं चाहते थे कि मैं उन पर राज्य करूँ, यहाँ लाकर मेरे सामने मार डालो।'"
hi.B: और मेरे उन शत्रुओं को, जो नहीं चाहते थे कि मैं उनका राजा बनूँ, यहाँ लाओ और मेरे सामने उन्हें मौत के घाट उतार दो।'"
hi.R: और मेरे उन दुश्मनों को यहाँ ले आओ जो नहीं चाहते थे कि मैं उनका राजा बनूँ। उन्हें यहीं मेरी आँखों के सामने मार डालो!'"

uk.L: А тих моїх ворогів, які не хотіли, щоб я царював над ними, приведіть сюди і заріжте їх переді мною.”»
uk.B: А цих моїх ворогів, які не хотіли мене за царя, приведіть сюди й стратіть у мене на очах.”»
uk.R: І приведіть сюди тих моїх ворогів, які не хотіли, щоб я був їхнім царем. Убийте їх тут, переді мною!”»

ja.L: しかし、わたしが自分たちの上に王として治めることを望まなかった、わたしのこれらの敵どもを、ここに連れて来て、わたしの前で打ち殺せ。』」
ja.B: また、わたしが王になることを望まなかったあの敵どもは、ここに引いて来て、わたしの前で処刑せよ。』」
ja.R: それから、わたしが王になるのをいやがった敵どもを、ここに連れて来なさい。そして、わたしの目の前で殺しなさい！』」

decisions.choice: these enemies: in the story, the citizens who rejected the king; Jesus warns of judgment on those who reject him
decisions.reason: The words belong to the king in the story, and they finish what began in 19:14. Kings of the time often put rebels to death when they took power. Jesus is about to enter Jerusalem, where he will weep over the city's coming judgment (19:41-44).

decisions.choice: slaughter: kill, put to death
decisions.reason: The verb is a strong one, used of slaughtering animals and of killing in battle.

decisions.choice: but: now turning to another matter
decisions.reason: The word marks a change of subject: from the slaves to the enemies.

decisions.choice: the parable ends here, closing the king's words and Jesus' speech
decisions.reason: Jesus' speech began at 19:12.

decisions.choice: "쳐 죽이다" (L); "처형하다" (B); "죽이다" (R) for katasphazo
decisions.reason: Put to death (meaning decision); Balanced uses the word for an execution ordered by a king.

decisions.choice: "አርዱአቸው" (slaughter them, L); "ግደሏቸው" (kill them, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is a strong one, used of slaughtering; Literal keeps that force, and Balanced and Readable say "kill", as the English "execute" and "kill".

source.text: Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα ἐπορεύετο ἔμπροσθεν ἀναβαίνων εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

records.literal_gloss: And having said these [things] he was going ahead going up to Jerusalem.

en.L: And having said these things, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
en.B: After saying this, Jesus went on ahead of them, going up to Jerusalem.
en.R: When Jesus had finished telling this story, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went on ahead of the others on the road up to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y habiendo dicho estas cosas, iba delante, subiendo a Jerusalén.
es.B: Después de decir esto, Jesús siguió adelante, delante de ellos, subiendo hacia Jerusalén.
es.R: Cuando Jesús terminó de contar esta historia, siguió caminando delante de los demás por el camino que sube a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et, après avoir dit ces choses, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} marchait devant, montant à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Après avoir dit cela, Jésus partit devant eux pour monter à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Quand Jésus a fini de raconter cette histoire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a continué la route devant les autres, en montant vers Jérusalem.

sw.L: Na akiisha kusema hayo, alienda mbele, akipanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Baada ya kusema hayo, Yesu aliendelea mbele yao, akipanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yesu alipomaliza kuwaambia mfano huo, alitangulia mbele ya wengine katika njia inayopanda kwenda Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Và sau khi nói những điều ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi trước, lên Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Nói xong những điều ấy, Đức Giê-xu đi trước họ, lên Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Sau khi kể xong câu chuyện ấy, Đức Giê-xu đi trước những người khác, trên con đường đi lên Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 이것들을 말씀하신 뒤에, 그분이 앞장서서 가시며 예루살렘으로 올라가셨다.
ko.B: 이렇게 말씀하신 뒤에, 예수께서는 앞장서서 예루살렘으로 올라가셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 이 비유를 다 말씀하신 뒤에, 다른 사람들보다 앞서서 예루살렘으로 올라가는 길을 가셨다.

pt.L: E, tendo dito essas coisas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seguia adiante, subindo para Jerusalém.
pt.B: Depois de dizer isso, Jesus seguiu à frente deles, subindo para Jerusalém.
pt.R: Quando acabou de contar essa história, Jesus foi na frente dos outros pela estrada que sobe para Jerusalém.

am.L: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እየወጣ ወደ ፊት ይሄድ ነበር።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ይህን ከተናገረ በኋላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እየወጣ ከእነርሱ ቀድሞ ሄደ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ይህን ታሪክ ተናግሮ ከጨረሰ በኋላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በሚወስደው ዳገት መንገድ ከሌሎቹ ቀድሞ ሄደ።

ru.L: И, сказав это, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пошёл дальше впереди, поднимаясь в Иерусалим.
ru.B: Сказав это, Иисус пошёл впереди них, поднимаясь в Иерусалим.
ru.R: Когда Иисус закончил рассказывать эту притчу, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пошёл впереди всех по дороге, которая поднимается в Иерусалим.

hi.L: और ये बातें कहकर वे यरूशलेम को ऊपर जाते हुए आगे-आगे चलने लगे।
hi.B: यह कहने के बाद यीशु यरूशलेम की ओर ऊपर जाते हुए उनके आगे-आगे चले।
hi.R: यह कहानी सुनाने के बाद यीशु दूसरों के आगे-आगे यरूशलेम की ओर चढ़ाई के रास्ते पर चल पड़े।

uk.L: І, сказавши це, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ішов попереду, підіймаючись до Єрусалима.
uk.B: Сказавши це, Ісус пішов попереду них, підіймаючись до Єрусалима.
uk.R: Коли Ісус закінчив розповідати цю притчу, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пішов попереду інших дорогою, що вела вгору до Єрусалима.

ja.L: そして、これらのことを言われると、[イエスは]先に立って進んで行かれ、エルサレムへ上って行かれた。
ja.B: イエスはこのように話されてから、先に立って、エルサレムへ上って行かれた。
ja.R: イエスは、このたとえを話し終えられると、ほかの人たちより先に立って、エルサレムへ上る道を進んで行かれました。

decisions.choice: going up to Jerusalem: climbing from Jericho to the city
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stands in the hills, and the road from Jericho climbs steeply. People spoke of going up to Jerusalem whatever direction they came from (2:42; 18:31).

decisions.choice: went on ahead: leading the way to the city where he would suffer
decisions.reason: Since 9:51 Jesus has set his face to go to Jerusalem. He leads his followers there, knowing what will happen (18:31-33).

decisions.choice: of them (B); of the others (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek "ahead" means ahead of those with him.

source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤγγισεν εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανίαν πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν, ἀπέστειλεν δύο τῶν μαθητῶν λέγων· Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κατέναντι κώμην, ἐν ᾗ εἰσπορευόμενοι εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον, ἐφ’ ὃν οὐδεὶς πώποτε ἀνθρώπων ἐκάθισεν, καὶ λύσαντες αὐτὸν ἀγάγετε.

records.literal_gloss: And it came about as he drew near to Bethphage and Bethany toward the mount the [one] being called of Olives, he sent two of the disciples \v 30 saying, Go into the opposite village, in which entering you will find a colt having been tied, on which no one ever of men has sat, and having untied it bring [it].

en.L: And it happened, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drew near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount that is called [the Mount] of Olives, [that] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent two of the disciples, \v 30 saying, "Go into the village opposite, where on entering you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever yet sat. Untie it and bring [it].
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came near Bethphage and Bethany, by the hill called the Mount of Olives, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent off two of the disciples. \v 30 "Go to the village ahead of you," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them. "As you go into it, you will find a young donkey tied there, one that nobody has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
en.R: Jesus came near the villages of Bethphage and Bethany, at the hill called the Mount of Olives. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent two of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers ahead. \v 30 He said to them, "Go into the village in front of you. As soon as you go in, you will find a young donkey tied up. No one has ever ridden it. Untie it and bring it to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando se acercó a Betfagé y Betania, junto al monte llamado de los Olivos, envió a dos de los discípulos, \v 30 diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a la aldea de enfrente, en la cual, al entrar, {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}} un pollino atado, sobre el cual ningún hombre se ha sentado jamás; {{plural_you:desátenlo|desatadlo}} y {{plural_you:tráiganlo|traedlo}}.
es.B: Cuando se acercaba a Betfagé y a Betania, junto al cerro llamado monte de los Olivos, envió a dos de los discípulos. \v 30 «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a la aldea que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} delante —les dijo—. Al entrar en ella, {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}} atado un pollino que nadie ha montado nunca. {{plural_you:Desátenlo|Desatadlo}} y {{plural_you:tráiganlo|traedlo}} aquí.
es.R: Jesús se acercó a los pueblos de Betfagé y Betania, junto al cerro llamado monte de los Olivos. Allí envió por delante a dos de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos. \v 30 Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} al pueblo que está ahí delante. En cuanto {{plural_you:entren|entréis}}, {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}} un burrito atado. Nadie lo ha montado nunca. {{plural_you:Desátenlo|Desatadlo}} y {{plural_you:tráiganmelo|traédmelo}}.

fr.L: Et il arriva, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} approchait de Bethphagé et de Béthanie, vers le mont appelé [mont] des Oliviers, [qu’]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} envoya deux des disciples, \v 30 disant : « Allez au village qui est en face ; en y entrant, vous trouverez un poulain attaché, sur lequel personne n’est encore jamais monté ; détachez-le et amenez[-le].
fr.B: Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} approchait de Bethphagé et de Béthanie, près de la colline qu’on appelle le mont des Oliviers, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} envoya deux des disciples. \v 30 « Allez au village qui est devant vous, leur dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}. En y entrant, vous trouverez un ânon attaché, que personne n’a encore jamais monté. Détachez-le et amenez-le ici.
fr.R: Jésus est arrivé près des villages de Bethphagé et de Béthanie, près de la colline qu’on appelle le mont des Oliviers. Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a envoyé deux de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples en avant. \v 30 Il leur a dit : « Allez dans le village qui est devant vous. Dès que vous y entrerez, vous trouverez un jeune âne attaché. Personne ne l’a encore jamais monté. Détachez-le et amenez-le-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Ikawa alipokaribia Bethfage na Bethania, karibu na mlima uitwao [Mlima] wa Mizeituni, aliwatuma wawili wa wanafunzi, \v 30 akisema, "Nendeni katika kijiji kilicho mkabala, ambamo mtakapoingia mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa, ambaye juu yake hajapata kuketi mtu yeyote kamwe; mfungueni, mmlete.
sw.B: Alipokaribia Bethfage na Bethania, karibu na kilima kiitwacho Mlima wa Mizeituni, aliwatuma wanafunzi wawili. \v 30 Akawaambia, "Nendeni katika kijiji kilicho mbele yenu. Mtakapoingia humo, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa, ambaye hajawahi kupandwa na mtu yeyote. Mfungueni, mmlete hapa.
sw.R: Yesu alikaribia vijiji vya Bethfage na Bethania, karibu na kilima kiitwacho Mlima wa Mizeituni. Huko aliwatuma wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wawili watangulie. \v 30 Akawaambia, "Nendeni katika kijiji kilicho mbele yenu. Mara mtakapoingia, mtamkuta punda mchanga amefungwa. Hakuna mtu aliyewahi kumpanda. Mfungueni, mmlete {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần Bết-pha-giê và Bê-tha-ni, gần núi gọi là [núi] Ô-li-ve, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai hai môn đồ, \v 30 nói: "Hãy đi vào làng ở phía trước, ở đó khi vào, các con sẽ thấy một con lừa con bị buộc, chưa có người nào từng ngồi lên; hãy mở dây nó và dắt [nó] về.
vi.B: Khi đến gần Bết-pha-giê và Bê-tha-ni, bên ngọn đồi gọi là núi Ô-li-ve, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai hai môn đồ đi \v 30 và dặn họ: "Hãy vào làng phía trước các con. Vừa vào làng, các con sẽ thấy một con lừa con đang bị buộc ở đó, chưa ai từng cưỡi. Hãy mở dây và dắt nó về đây.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đến gần hai làng Bết-pha-giê và Bê-tha-ni, gần ngọn đồi gọi là núi Ô-li-ve. Ở đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai hai môn đồ đi trước. \v 30 Ngài dặn họ: "Hãy vào cái làng ở phía trước các con. Vừa vào làng, các con sẽ thấy một con lừa con đang bị buộc. Chưa ai từng cưỡi nó. Hãy mở dây và dắt nó về cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그분이 올리브 산이라고 불리는 산 쪽에 있는 벳바게와 베다니에 가까이 오셨을 때에, 제자들 가운데 둘을 보내시며 \v 30 말씀하셨다. "맞은편 마을로 가거라. 그 안으로 들어가면, 아직 사람들 가운데 아무도 탄 적이 없는 나귀 새끼 한 마리가 매여 있는 것을 너희가 발견할 것이다. 그것을 풀어서 끌고 오너라.
ko.B: 예수께서 올리브 산이라고 하는 산 근처의 벳바게와 베다니에 가까이 이르셨을 때에, 제자 두 사람을 보내시며 \v 30 이렇게 이르셨다. "맞은편 마을로 가거라. 거기 들어가면, 아직 아무도 타 본 적이 없는 어린 나귀 한 마리가 매여 있는 것을 보게 될 것이다. 그것을 풀어서 끌고 오너라.
ko.R: 예수께서 벳바게와 베다니라는 마을 가까이 오셨다. 그곳은 올리브 산이라고 하는 언덕에 있었다. 거기서 예수께서 제자 두 사람을 먼저 보내셨다. \v 30 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "앞에 보이는 마을로 가거라. 거기 들어가면 어린 나귀 한 마리가 매여 있을 것이다. 아직 아무도 타 본 적이 없는 나귀다. 그 나귀를 풀어서 나에게 끌고 오너라.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se aproximou de Betfagé e Betânia, junto ao monte chamado das Oliveiras, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviou dois dos discípulos, \v 30 dizendo: "Vão ao povoado que está defronte, onde, ao entrarem, vocês encontrarão um jumentinho amarrado, no qual ninguém jamais se sentou. Desamarrem-no e tragam[-no].
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} chegou perto de Betfagé e de Betânia, junto ao monte chamado das Oliveiras, enviou dois dos discípulos. \v 30 "Vão ao povoado que está à frente de vocês", {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse. "Ao entrarem, vão encontrar ali um jumentinho amarrado, em que ninguém nunca montou. Desamarrem o animal e tragam-no aqui.
pt.R: Jesus chegou perto dos povoados de Betfagé e Betânia, junto ao monte das Oliveiras. Ali {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mandou dois dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores irem na frente. \v 30 Ele disse a eles: "Vão ao povoado que está na frente de vocês. Logo que entrarem, vão encontrar um jumentinho amarrado. Ninguém nunca montou nele. Desamarrem o jumentinho e tragam para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: ደብረ ዘይት ወደሚባለው ተራራ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላከ፤ \v 30 እንዲህም አለ፦ «በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፤ በገባችሁባትም ጊዜ ከሰዎች ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት የታሰረ ውርንጫ ታገኛላችሁ፤ ፈትታችሁም አምጡት።
am.B: ደብረ ዘይት በሚባለው ኮረብታ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላካቸው። \v 30 «ከፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ።» አላቸው። «ወደ እርሷ ስትገቡ ማንም ገና ተቀምጦበት የማያውቅ ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ። ፈትታችሁ ወደዚህ አምጡት።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ደብረ ዘይት በሚባለው ኮረብታ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ መንደሮች ቀረበ። በዚያም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ቀድመው እንዲሄዱ ላካቸው። \v 30 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ከፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ። ወደ እርሷ እንደ ገባችሁ ታስሮ የቆመ ውርንጫ ታገኛላችሁ። ማንም ሰው ገና ተቀምጦበት አያውቅም። ፈትታችሁ ወደ እኔ አምጡት።

ru.L: И случилось, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} приблизился к Виффагии и Вифании, к горе, называемой Масличной, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} послал двух из учеников, \v 30 говоря: «Идите в селение, что напротив, в котором, входя, найдёте привязанного ослёнка, на которого никто никогда не садился; отвязав его, приведите.
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} подходил к Виффагии и Вифании, у горы, которая называется Масличной, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} послал вперёд двух учеников. \v 30 «Идите в селение, что перед вами», — сказал {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} им. — «Как только войдёте туда, найдёте привязанного ослёнка, на котором ещё никто никогда не ездил. Отвяжите его и приведите сюда.
ru.R: Иисус подошёл к селениям Виффагия и Вифания у горы, которая называется Масличной. Оттуда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} послал вперёд двух своих учеников. \v 30 Он сказал им: «Идите в селение, которое перед вами. Как только вы туда войдёте, вы найдёте привязанного ослёнка. На нём ещё никто никогда не ездил. Отвяжите его и приведите ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब वे जैतून [का पहाड़] कहलानेवाले पहाड़ के पास बैतफ़गे और बैतनिय्याह के निकट पहुँचे, तो उन्होंने चेलों में से दो को भेजा, \v 30 यह कहते हुए, "सामने के गाँव में जाओ; उसमें प्रवेश करते ही तुम्हें एक बछेरा बँधा हुआ मिलेगा, जिस पर अब तक कोई मनुष्य नहीं बैठा। उसे खोलकर ले आओ।
hi.B: जब वे जैतून पहाड़ कहलानेवाली पहाड़ी के पास बैतफ़गे और बैतनिय्याह के निकट आए, तो उन्होंने दो चेलों को आगे भेजा। \v 30 "अपने सामने वाले गाँव में जाओ," उन्होंने उनसे कहा। "उसमें घुसते ही तुम्हें वहाँ एक बछेरा बँधा हुआ मिलेगा, जिस पर आज तक कोई सवार नहीं हुआ। उसे खोलकर यहाँ ले आओ।
hi.R: यीशु बैतफ़गे और बैतनिय्याह गाँवों के पास पहुँचे, जो जैतून पहाड़ कहलानेवाली पहाड़ी पर थे। वहाँ से उन्होंने अपने दो चेलों को आगे भेजा। \v 30 उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "अपने सामने वाले गाँव में जाओ। वहाँ पहुँचते ही तुम्हें गदहे का एक बच्चा बँधा हुआ मिलेगा। उस पर आज तक कोई सवार नहीं हुआ है। उसे खोलकर मेरे पास ले आओ।

uk.L: І сталося, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наблизився до Вітфагії і Віфанії, до гори, що зветься Оливною, [що] {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} послав двох з учнів, \v 30 кажучи: «Ідіть у село, що навпроти, і, входячи в нього, знайдете привʼязане осля, на якому ніхто з людей ніколи не сидів. Відвʼяжіть його і приведіть.
uk.B: Коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наближався до Вітфагії та Віфанії, біля гори, що зветься Оливною, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} послав двох учнів. \v 30 «Ідіть у село, що перед вами», — сказав {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} їм. — «Коли ввійдете туди, знайдете привʼязане осля, на якому ще ніхто ніколи не їздив. Відвʼяжіть його й приведіть сюди.
uk.R: Ісус підійшов до сіл Вітфагії та Віфанії, біля гори, яку називають Оливною. Звідти {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} послав уперед двох своїх учнів. \v 30 Він сказав їм: «Ідіть у село, що перед вами. Щойно ви туди ввійдете, то знайдете привʼязане осля. На ньому ще ніхто ніколи не їздив. Відвʼяжіть його й приведіть до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.

ja.L: そして、[イエスが]オリーブ山と呼ばれる山のそばの、ベトファゲとベタニアに近づかれたとき、[次のことが]起こった。[イエスは]弟子たちのうちの二人を遣わして、\v 30 言われた。「向かいの村へ行きなさい。そこに入ると、まだ人のだれも乗ったことのない子ろばがつながれているのを、あなたがたは見つけるだろう。それをほどいて、引いて来なさい。
ja.B: イエスは、オリーブ山と呼ばれる山のそばの、ベトファゲとベタニアに近づかれたとき、二人の弟子を使いに出された。\v 30 「向こうの村へ行きなさい」とイエスは言われた。「村に入ると、まだだれも乗ったことのない子ろばがつないであるのが見つかる。それをほどいて、ここへ引いて来なさい。
ja.R: イエスは、オリーブ山と呼ばれる丘のそばにある、ベトファゲとベタニアという村の近くまで来られました。そこでイエスは、二人の弟子を先に遣わされました。\v 30 イエスは二人に言われました。「前に見える村へ行きなさい。村に入ったらすぐ、子ろばがつながれているのが見つかる。まだだれも乗ったことのないろばだ。それをほどいて、わたしのところへ引いて来なさい。

decisions.choice: Bethphage and Bethany, the Mount of Olives: villages on the hill east of Jerusalem, on the road from Jericho
decisions.reason: The Mount of Olives faces Jerusalem across the Kidron valley. Bethany lay about two miles from the city (John 11:18), and Bethphage was nearer. Zechariah 14:4 speaks of the LORD standing on the Mount of Olives on the day he comes.

decisions.choice: colt: a young animal, here a young donkey
decisions.reason: The word means the young of an animal. Mark 11:2 and John 12:14-15 show it was a donkey, as in Zechariah 9:9, where Zion's king comes humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt.

decisions.choice: on which no one has ever sat: an animal not yet used, fit for a sacred purpose
decisions.reason: Animals set apart for God were ones that had never been put to work (Numbers 19:2; Deuteronomy 21:3; 1 Samuel 6:7).

decisions.choice: the colt: Jesus comes as the king of Zechariah 9:9
decisions.reason: Jesus had walked all the way from Galilee. Riding into the city on a colt acts out the prophecy of the humble king (Zechariah 9:9), which Matthew 21:5 and John 12:15 quote.

decisions.choice: young donkey
decisions.reason: Today a colt is usually a young horse. Balanced and Readable say what animal it was (m2); Literal keeps "colt".

decisions.choice: Jesus' words open here and continue to the end of 19:31
decisions.reason: His instructions go on in 19:31.

decisions.choice: to me
decisions.reason: Readable says where to bring it.

decisions.choice: discípulos at every level
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "followers"; the shared term sheet keeps "discípulos" at every level in Spanish, a word Spanish readers know, so the Gospels read alike.

decisions.choice: pollino (L, B); burrito (R)
decisions.reason: A colt here is a young donkey (meaning decision m2). "Pollino" is the word for it, as in Matthew 21; Readable uses the everyday "burrito".

decisions.choice: un poulain (L); un ânon (B); un jeune âne (R)
alternatives: un poulain at Literal and Balanced, as in Mark 11
decisions.reason: The word names the young of an animal, here a young donkey (m2). Literal keeps the general word, as the English keeps "colt". The English Balanced says "young donkey" here, and French has a plain word for it, "ânon"; Readable says "jeune âne", as in Mark 11. This holds for 19:30-35.

decisions.choice: disciples at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: English Readable says "followers"; as in Mark, French keeps "les disciples" at every level, where the word is familiar and plain. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi at every level
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "followers"; the shared term sheet keeps "wanafunzi" at every level in Swahili, as in John, so the Gospels read alike.

decisions.choice: mwana-punda (L, B); punda mchanga (R)
decisions.reason: A colt here is a young donkey (meaning decision m2). "Mwana-punda" is the word used in Matthew 21; Readable says plainly "punda mchanga", a young donkey.

decisions.choice: "Bết-pha-giê", "Bê-tha-ni", "núi Ô-li-ve"; "lừa con"; "các con" for the disciples
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 11:1-2, so the parallel accounts read alike.

decisions.choice: "môn đồ" at every level (also 19:37)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "môn đồ" at every level, where the English Readable says "followers".

decisions.choice: "벳바게", "베다니", "올리브 산"; "나귀 새끼" (L), "어린 나귀" (B, R) for polos, through 19:35
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Mark 11:1-7, where the Greek is alike.

decisions.choice: "제자들" at every level, Readable included, through Luke 19-21
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 7:18 and Mark; the English Readable's "followers" is not followed.

decisions.choice: um jumentinho (every level)
decisions.reason: "Jumentinho" says both that the animal is young and that it is a donkey (m2), as Mark 11:2 has it in Portuguese; Literal needs no other word, unlike the English "colt", which today suggests a young horse. "Potro" is a young horse.

decisions.choice: "ደብረ ዘይት" (the Mount of Olives); "ውርንጫ" (colt)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 21:1-2: "ደብረ ዘይት" is the established Amharic name of the hill, and "ውርንጫ" the ordinary word for a young donkey, so the Gospels read alike here.

decisions.choice: "ослёнок"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:2: the word means a young animal, here a young donkey, and Russian has one word for it at every level.

decisions.choice: "ученики" at Readable
decisions.reason: As settled in Matthew, disciples are "ученики" at every level, where the English Readable says "followers" (also 19:37, 19:39-40).

decisions.choice: "बछेरा" (L, B); "गदहे का बच्चा" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:2-7, where the Greek is the same: "बछेरा" is a young animal, and Readable says it was a young donkey (meaning decision m2). Jesus' instructions keep Mark's wording.

decisions.choice: "осля" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word means a young animal, here a young donkey (Zechariah 9:9); "осля" says both in one word. "Лоша" would mean a foal of a horse. R says "учнів" where the English Readable says "followers", keeping the settled "учні".

decisions.choice: "子ろば" (every level), with the entry (19:29-36) worded as Mark 11:1-8 in Japanese where the Greek is the same
decisions.reason: The word means a young animal, and Mark 11:2 and John 12:14-15 show it was a donkey (m2). Japanese has no word like "colt" that a reader would take for a horse, so even Literal says "子ろば", as the Japanese of Mark 11 does. Where Luke has the same words as Mark, the Japanese keeps Mark's wording.

ja.R: 二人が子ろばをほどいていると、持ち主たちが聞きました。「なぜ、わたしたちの子ろばをほどいているのか？」

decisions.choice: owners: the people the colt belonged to
decisions.reason: The same word that means "lord" here means the owners of property. Luke sets them beside "the Lord" who needs it (19:34).

decisions.choice: owners
decisions.reason: The sense here is ownership (m1).

decisions.choice: young donkey; donkey
decisions.reason: As in 19:30.

decisions.choice: "주인들" for kyrioi, the owners
decisions.reason: The same Greek word as "the Lord" in 19:31 and 19:34; Korean cannot keep the wordplay and uses the ordinary word for owners.

decisions.choice: "ባለቤቶቹ" (its owners)
decisions.reason: The Greek calls the owners by the same word as "the Lord" in 19:31 and 19:34. Amharic "ጌቶቹ" would sound like masters of slaves, so the owners are "ባለቤቶቹ", and the play on the word is lost, as in English.
The Greek uses the same word for the colt's owners and for "the Lord" who needs it; Hindi has to choose, and the owners are "मालिक" while the Lord is "प्रभु" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "господарі" for the owners (*kyrioi*)
decisions.reason: The same Greek word as "the Lord" in 19:31 and 19:34; Ukrainian cannot keep the play on words, and "господарі" is the natural word for owners of an animal.

decisions.choice: "持ち主たち" (every level)
decisions.reason: The word that means "lord" here means owners (m1). "持ち主" contains the same character as "主" in the disciples' answer (19:34), so a little of Luke's contrast between the owners and the Lord comes through.

source.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ὅτι Ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει.

records.literal_gloss: They then said that The Lord of it need has.

en.L: And they said, "The Lord has need of it."
en.B: They answered, "The Lord needs it."
en.R: They answered, "The Lord needs it."

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «El Señor tiene necesidad de él».
es.B: Ellos respondieron: «El Señor lo necesita».
es.R: Ellos respondieron: «El Señor lo necesita».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Le Seigneur en a besoin. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent : « Le Seigneur en a besoin. »
fr.R: Ils ont répondu : « Le Seigneur en a besoin. »

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Bwana ana haja naye."
sw.B: Wakajibu, "Bwana anamhitaji."
sw.R: Wakajibu, "Bwana anamhitaji."

vi.L: Và họ nói: "Chúa cần đến nó."
vi.B: Họ đáp: "Chúa cần nó."
vi.R: Họ trả lời: "Chúa cần nó."

ko.L: 그들이 말했다. "주님께서 그것이 필요하십니다."
ko.B: 그들이 대답했다. "주님께서 쓰시려고 하십니다."
ko.R: 제자들이 대답했다. "주님께서 쓰실 데가 있으십니다."

pt.L: E eles disseram: "O Senhor tem necessidade dele."
pt.B: Eles responderam: "O Senhor precisa dele."
pt.R: Eles responderam: "O Senhor precisa dele."

am.L: እነርሱም «ጌታ ያስፈልገዋል።» አሉ።
am.B: እነርሱም «ጌታ ያስፈልገዋል።» ብለው መለሱ።
am.R: እነርሱም «ጌታ ያስፈልገዋል።» ብለው መለሱ።

ru.L: Они же сказали: «Господу он нужен.»
ru.B: Они ответили: «Он нужен Господу.»
ru.R: Они ответили: «Он нужен Господу.»

hi.L: उन्होंने कहा, "प्रभु को इसकी ज़रूरत है।"
hi.B: उन्होंने उत्तर दिया, "प्रभु को इसकी ज़रूरत है।"
hi.R: उन्होंने उत्तर दिया, "प्रभु को इसकी ज़रूरत है।"

uk.L: Вони ж сказали: «Господь потребує його.»
uk.B: Вони відповіли: «Воно потрібне Господу.»
uk.R: Вони відповіли: «Воно потрібне Господу.»

ja.L: すると彼らは言った。「主がそれを必要としておられるのです。」
ja.B: 二人は答えた。「主がそれを必要としておられるのです。」
ja.R: 二人は答えました。「主が使われるのです。」

decisions.choice: the Lord: Jesus, as in 19:31
decisions.reason: The disciples give the answer Jesus told them to give, and the owners let them go. Luke contrasts the owners with the Lord who has a greater claim.

source.text: καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἐπιρίψαντες αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐπὶ τὸν πῶλον ἐπεβίβασαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν·

records.literal_gloss: And they brought it to the Jesus, and having thrown of them the cloaks on the colt they set on [it] the Jesus;

en.L: And they brought it to Jesus, and throwing their cloaks on the colt, they set Jesus on [it].
en.B: They brought the donkey to Jesus, threw their cloaks over it, and helped Jesus get on.
en.R: They brought the young donkey to Jesus. They put their coats on the donkey's back, and they helped Jesus get up on it.

es.L: Y lo llevaron a Jesús, y echando sus mantos sobre el pollino, montaron [en él] a Jesús.
es.B: Llevaron el pollino a Jesús, le echaron encima sus mantos y ayudaron a Jesús a montar.
es.R: Le llevaron el burrito a Jesús. Pusieron sus capas sobre el lomo del burrito y ayudaron a Jesús a subirse.

fr.L: Et ils l’amenèrent à Jésus, et, ayant jeté leurs manteaux sur le poulain, ils firent monter Jésus [dessus].
fr.B: Ils amenèrent l’ânon à Jésus, jetèrent leurs manteaux dessus et aidèrent Jésus à y monter.
fr.R: Ils ont amené le jeune âne à Jésus. Ils ont mis leurs manteaux sur son dos, et ils ont aidé Jésus à monter dessus.

sw.L: Wakamleta kwa Yesu, na wakiisha kutupa mavazi yao juu ya mwana-punda, wakampandisha Yesu [juu yake].
sw.B: Walimleta mwana-punda kwa Yesu, wakatandika mavazi yao ya nje juu yake, wakamsaidia Yesu kupanda.
sw.R: Walimleta punda mchanga kwa Yesu. Wakaweka makoti yao mgongoni mwa punda, wakamsaidia Yesu apande juu yake.

vi.L: Và họ dắt nó đến với Đức Giê-xu, và ném áo ngoài của họ lên con lừa con, rồi đặt Đức Giê-xu ngồi lên.
vi.B: Họ dắt con lừa đến với Đức Giê-xu, trải áo ngoài của mình lên lưng nó, rồi đỡ Đức Giê-xu lên ngồi.
vi.R: Họ dắt con lừa con đến với Đức Giê-xu. Họ trải áo khoác của mình lên lưng nó và đỡ Đức Giê-xu lên ngồi.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그것을 예수께 끌고 와서, 자기들의 겉옷을 나귀 새끼 위에 걸쳐 놓고 예수를 태워 드렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 어린 나귀를 예수께 끌고 와서, 그 위에 자기들의 겉옷을 걸쳐 놓고 예수를 태워 드렸다.
ko.R: 제자들은 어린 나귀를 예수께 끌고 왔다. 그리고 자기들의 겉옷을 나귀 등에 얹고, 예수께서 그 위에 타시도록 도와 드렸다.

pt.L: E o trouxeram a Jesus e, lançando os seus mantos sobre o jumentinho, fizeram Jesus montar [nele].
pt.B: Levaram o jumentinho a Jesus, jogaram os seus mantos sobre ele e ajudaram Jesus a montar.
pt.R: Eles levaram o jumentinho até Jesus. Puseram as suas capas nas costas do animal e ajudaram Jesus a subir nele.

am.L: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጡት፤ ልብሶቻቸውንም በውርንጫው ላይ ጥለው ኢየሱስን [በላዩ] አስቀመጡት።
am.B: ውርንጫውን ወደ ኢየሱስ አመጡት፤ ልብሶቻቸውንም በላዩ ጣል አድርገው ኢየሱስን አስቀመጡት።
am.R: ውርንጫውን ወደ ኢየሱስ አመጡት። ልብሳቸውን በውርንጫው ጀርባ ላይ አነጠፉ፤ ኢየሱስም እንዲቀመጥበት ረዱት።

ru.L: И привели его к Иисусу, и, набросив свои плащи на ослёнка, посадили на него Иисуса.
ru.B: Они привели ослёнка к Иисусу, набросили на него свои плащи и помогли Иисусу сесть.
ru.R: Они привели ослёнка к Иисусу. Они положили свои накидки ему на спину и помогли Иисусу сесть на него.

hi.L: और वे उसे यीशु के पास ले आए, और बछेरे पर अपने चोग़े डालकर यीशु को [उस पर] बैठाया।
hi.B: वे बछेरे को यीशु के पास ले आए, उस पर अपने चोग़े डाल दिए, और यीशु को उस पर बैठने में मदद की।
hi.R: वे गदहे के बच्चे को यीशु के पास ले आए। उन्होंने उसकी पीठ पर अपने ऊपर के कपड़े डाल दिए, और यीशु को उस पर बैठने में मदद की।

uk.L: І привели його до Ісуса, і, накинувши свій одяг на осля, посадили Ісуса.
uk.B: Вони привели осля до Ісуса, накинули на нього свої плащі й допомогли Ісусові сісти.
uk.R: Учні привели осля до Ісуса. Вони поклали свій верхній одяг на спину ослятові й допомогли Ісусові сісти на нього.

ja.L: そして彼らはそれをイエスのところに引いて来た。そして自分たちの上着を子ろばの上に投げ掛けて、イエスを[その上に]乗せた。
ja.B: 二人は子ろばをイエスのところに引いて来て、その背に自分たちの上着を掛け、イエスを乗せた。
ja.R: 二人は、子ろばをイエスのところに連れて来ました。そして、その背中に自分たちの上着をかけて、イエスが乗られるのを手伝いました。

decisions.choice: cloaks: outer garments, used here as a saddle
decisions.reason: The cloak was the outer robe, worn over the tunic and used as a blanket at night (6:29). The disciples use theirs to make a seat for Jesus.

decisions.choice: they set Jesus on it: as Solomon was set on David's mule to be made king
decisions.reason: When Solomon was to be made king, David had him ride on the king's own mule into the city (1 Kings 1:33-40). Jesus is honored as a king by his followers.

decisions.choice: helped Jesus get on
decisions.reason: The verb means to put someone on a mount. Balanced and Readable say it in plain words.

decisions.choice: coats
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common word for the outer garment.

decisions.choice: mantos (L, B); capas (R)
decisions.reason: The outer garment, laid on the colt as a saddle (meaning decision m1). The term used through the Gospels; Readable's "capas" matches the English Readable's "coats" without suggesting a modern overcoat.

decisions.choice: mavazi (L); mavazi ya nje (B); makoti (R)
decisions.reason: The outer garment, laid on the colt as a saddle (meaning decision m1). The term used through the Gospels; Readable's "makoti" matches the English Readable's "coats".

decisions.choice: "áo ngoài" (L, B); "áo khoác" (R) for the cloaks (also 19:36)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:7-8.

decisions.choice: "겉옷" at every level; "태워 드렸다" (L, B), "타시도록 도와 드렸다" (R)
decisions.reason: "드리다" honours Jesus in what the disciples do for him; "겉옷" as in the Korean Mark 11:7.

source.text: πορευομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ὑπεστρώννυον τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Going then of him they were spreading the cloaks of themselves on the road.

en.L: And as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went along, they were spreading their cloaks on the road.
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rode along, people spread their cloaks on the road.
en.R: As Jesus rode along, people spread their coats on the road in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} avanzaba, extendían sus mantos en el camino.
es.B: Mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} avanzaba montado, la gente tendía sus mantos en el camino.
es.R: Mientras Jesús avanzaba montado, la gente extendía sus capas en el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et tandis qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avançait, ils étendaient leurs manteaux sur le chemin.
fr.B: À mesure qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avançait, les gens étendaient leurs manteaux sur la route.
fr.R: Pendant que Jésus avançait sur l’âne, les gens ont étendu leurs manteaux sur la route devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Naye alipokuwa akienda, walikuwa wakitandika mavazi yao njiani.
sw.B: Alipokuwa akiendelea na safari, watu walitandika mavazi yao ya nje barabarani.
sw.R: Yesu alipokuwa akiendelea kupanda punda, watu walitandika makoti yao barabarani mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi, người ta trải áo ngoài của mình trên đường.
vi.B: Ngài cưỡi lừa đi tới, và người ta trải áo ngoài của mình trên đường.
vi.R: Trong khi Đức Giê-xu cưỡi lừa đi, người ta trải áo khoác của mình trên đường phía trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분이 가고 계실 때에, 그들이 자기들의 겉옷을 길에 펴고 있었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 나귀를 타고 가시는 동안, 사람들이 자기들의 겉옷을 길에 깔았다.
ko.R: 예수께서 나귀를 타고 가실 때에, 사람들이 예수 앞의 길에 자기들의 겉옷을 깔았다.

pt.L: E, enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ia, estendiam os seus mantos no caminho.
pt.B: Enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seguia montado, as pessoas estendiam os seus mantos no caminho.
pt.R: Enquanto Jesus seguia montado no jumentinho, as pessoas estendiam as suas capas na estrada, na frente {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: እርሱም ሲሄድ ልብሶቻቸውን በመንገድ ላይ ያነጥፉ ነበር።
am.B: እየሄደ ሳለም ሰዎች ልብሶቻቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ በውርንጫው ላይ ተቀምጦ ሲሄድ ሰዎች ከፊቱ ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ።

ru.L: Когда же {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ехал, они расстилали свои плащи на дороге.
ru.B: Пока {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ехал, люди расстилали на дороге свои плащи.
ru.R: Пока Иисус ехал, люди расстилали свои накидки на дороге перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.

hi.L: और जब वे जा रहे थे, तो [लोग] अपने चोग़े मार्ग में बिछाते जाते थे।
hi.B: जब वे सवार होकर आगे बढ़े, तो लोगों ने अपने चोग़े सड़क पर बिछा दिए।
hi.R: जब यीशु गदहे पर सवार होकर जा रहे थे, तो लोगों ने उनके आगे सड़क पर अपने कपड़े बिछा दिए।

uk.L: Коли ж {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} їхав, вони стелили свій одяг на дорозі.
uk.B: Поки {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} їхав, люди стелили свої плащі на дорогу.
uk.R: Поки Ісус їхав, люди стелили свій одяг на дорогу перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.

ja.L: [イエスが]進んで行かれると、人々は自分たちの上着を道に敷いていった。
ja.B: イエスが進んで行かれると、人々は自分の上着を道に敷いた。
ja.R: イエスが子ろばに乗って進んで行かれると、人々はイエスの前の道に、自分の上着を敷きました。

decisions.choice: spreading their cloaks on the road: honoring a new king
decisions.reason: When Jehu was anointed king, the commanders spread their cloaks under him and proclaimed him king (2 Kings 9:13). The people greet Jesus as king.

decisions.choice: they were spreading: people kept spreading them as he went
decisions.reason: The imperfect describes something done again and again along the way. Luke does not mention branches, as Matthew 21:8 and Mark 11:8 do.

decisions.choice: in front of him
decisions.reason: Readable says where they spread them.

source.text: ἐγγίζοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἤδη πρὸς τῇ καταβάσει τοῦ Ὄρους τῶν Ἐλαιῶν ἤρξαντο ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν χαίροντες αἰνεῖν τὸν θεὸν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ περὶ πασῶν ὧν εἶδον δυνάμεων, λέγοντες· Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος βασιλεὺς ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου· ἐν οὐρανῷ εἰρήνη καὶ δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις.

records.literal_gloss: Drawing near then of him already at the descent of the Mount of the Olives they began all the multitude of the disciples rejoicing to praise the God with a voice loud for all which they had seen mighty works, \v 38 saying, Blessed the coming king in [the] name of [the] Lord; in heaven peace and glory in highest [places].

en.L: And as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was now drawing near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began, rejoicing, to praise God with a loud voice for all the works of power that they had seen, \v 38 saying, "Blessed [is] the King who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord! In heaven peace, and glory in [the] highest!"
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came close to the city, where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples began to praise God joyfully and loudly for all the mighty deeds they had seen. \v 38 They shouted, "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!"
en.R: Jesus came near the place where the road goes down from the Mount of Olives to Jerusalem. There the whole crowd of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers began to praise God. They were full of joy, and they shouted loudly to thank God for all the miracles they had seen. \v 38 They said, "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! There is peace in heaven, and glory to God in the highest heaven!"

es.L: Y acercándose {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya a la bajada del monte de los Olivos, toda la multitud de los discípulos, gozosos, comenzó a alabar a Dios a gran voz por todas las obras poderosas que habían visto, \v 38 diciendo: «¡Bendito el Rey que viene en [el] nombre del Señor! ¡En [el] cielo paz, y gloria en [las] alturas!».
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya estaba cerca de la ciudad, donde el camino baja del monte de los Olivos, toda la multitud de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos comenzó a alabar a Dios con alegría y a grandes voces por todas las obras poderosas que habían visto. \v 38 Gritaban: «¡Bendito el Rey que viene en el nombre del Señor! ¡Paz en el cielo, y gloria en las alturas!».
es.R: Jesús llegó cerca del lugar donde el camino baja del monte de los Olivos hacia Jerusalén. Allí toda la multitud de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos comenzó a alabar a Dios. Estaban llenos de alegría y gritaban fuerte para darle gracias a Dios por todos los milagros que habían visto. \v 38 Decían: «¡Bendito el Rey que viene en el nombre del Señor! ¡Hay paz en el cielo, y gloria a Dios en lo más alto del cielo!».

fr.L: Et comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} approchait déjà de la descente du mont des Oliviers, toute la multitude des disciples, se réjouissant, se mit à louer Dieu d’une voix forte pour tous les actes de puissance qu’ils avaient vus, \v 38 disant : « Béni [soit] le Roi qui vient au nom du Seigneur ! Dans le ciel paix, et gloire dans les lieux très hauts ! »
fr.B: Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} arrivait près de la ville, là où la route descend du mont des Oliviers, toute la foule de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, pleine de joie, se mit à louer Dieu à grands cris pour tous les actes puissants qu’ils avaient vus. \v 38 Ils criaient : « Béni soit le Roi qui vient au nom du Seigneur ! Paix dans le ciel, et gloire au plus haut des cieux ! »
fr.R: Jésus est arrivé près de l’endroit où la route descend du mont des Oliviers vers Jérusalem. Là, toute la foule de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples s’est mise à louer Dieu. Les gens étaient pleins de joie, et ils criaient fort pour remercier Dieu de tous les miracles qu’ils avaient vus. \v 38 Ils disaient : « Béni soit le Roi qui vient au nom du Seigneur ! Il y a la paix dans le ciel, et gloire à Dieu au plus haut des cieux ! »

sw.L: Na alipokuwa akikaribia, tayari kwenye mteremko wa Mlima wa Mizeituni, umati wote wa wanafunzi ulianza kumsifu Mungu kwa furaha kwa sauti kubwa kwa ajili ya matendo yote ya nguvu waliyokuwa wameyaona, \v 38 wakisema, "[Amebarikiwa] Mfalme anayekuja kwa jina la Bwana! Mbinguni amani, na utukufu katika [mbingu] zilizo juu kabisa!"
sw.B: Alipokaribia mji, mahali ambapo njia inateremka kutoka Mlima wa Mizeituni, umati wote wa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulianza kumsifu Mungu kwa furaha na kwa sauti kubwa, kwa sababu ya matendo yote ya nguvu waliyoyaona. \v 38 Walipaza sauti, "Amebarikiwa Mfalme anayekuja kwa jina la Bwana! Amani mbinguni, na utukufu huko juu kabisa!"
sw.R: Yesu alifika karibu na mahali ambapo njia inateremka kutoka Mlima wa Mizeituni kwenda Yerusalemu. Hapo umati wote wa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulianza kumsifu Mungu. Walijaa furaha, wakapaza sauti kubwa kumshukuru Mungu kwa miujiza yote waliyokuwa wameiona. \v 38 Walisema, "Amebarikiwa Mfalme anayekuja kwa jina la Bwana! Kuna amani mbinguni, na utukufu kwa Mungu juu kabisa mbinguni!"

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đến gần, tại chỗ xuống dốc núi Ô-li-ve, toàn thể đoàn môn đồ đông đảo bắt đầu vui mừng, lớn tiếng ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời vì mọi việc quyền năng họ đã thấy, \v 38 nói rằng: "Đáng chúc tụng [thay] Vua, Đấng đến trong danh [của] Chúa! Bình an trên trời, và vinh quang trên nơi chí cao!"
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần thành, tại chỗ con đường bắt đầu xuống dốc núi Ô-li-ve, cả đoàn môn đồ đông đảo bắt đầu vui mừng lớn tiếng ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời vì mọi việc quyền năng họ đã thấy. \v 38 Họ reo lên: "Chúc tụng Vua, Đấng đến trong danh Chúa! Bình an trên trời, và vinh quang trên các tầng trời cao nhất!"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đến gần chỗ con đường đi xuống từ núi Ô-li-ve về phía Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ở đó, cả đoàn môn đồ đông đảo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời. Họ rất vui mừng, và họ lớn tiếng cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời vì tất cả các phép lạ họ đã thấy. \v 38 Họ nói: "Cầu Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho Vua, là Đấng đến trong danh Chúa! Trên trời có bình an, và vinh quang thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời trên trời cao nhất!"

ko.L: 그분이 이미 올리브 산의 내리막길에 가까이 오셨을 때에, 제자들의 온 무리가 기뻐하며, 자기들이 본 모든 능력 있는 일들 때문에 큰 소리로 하나님을 찬양하기 시작하며 \v 38 말했다. "주님의 이름으로 오시는 왕께 복이 있기를! 하늘에는 평안, 가장 높은 곳에는 영광!"
ko.B: 예수께서 올리브 산에서 내려가는 길에 이르러 성 가까이 오셨을 때에, 제자들의 온 무리가 기뻐하며, 자기들이 본 모든 능력 있는 일 때문에 큰 소리로 하나님을 찬양하기 시작했다. \v 38 그들이 외쳤다. "주님의 이름으로 오시는 왕께 복이 있기를! 하늘에는 평안, 가장 높은 하늘에는 영광!"
