ko.R: 예수께서 올리브 산에서 예루살렘으로 내려가는 길에 가까이 오셨다. 그러자 예수를 따르는 제자들의 큰 무리가 모두 하나님을 찬양하기 시작했다. 그들은 기쁨에 넘쳤다. 그리고 자기들이 본 모든 기적 때문에 큰 소리로 하나님께 감사했다. \v 38 그들이 말했다. "주님께서 보내셔서 오시는 왕께 하나님께서 복을 주시기를! 하늘에는 평안이 있고, 가장 높은 하늘에서는 하나님께 영광을!"

pt.L: E, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} já se aproximava, na descida do monte das Oliveiras, toda a multidão dos discípulos começou, alegrando-se, a louvar a Deus em alta voz por todas as obras poderosas que tinham visto, \v 38 dizendo: "Bendito o Rei que vem em nome [do] Senhor! No céu paz, e glória nas alturas!"
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} já estava chegando perto da cidade, onde a estrada desce o monte das Oliveiras, toda a multidão dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos começou a louvar a Deus com alegria e em alta voz por todos os feitos poderosos que tinham visto. \v 38 Eles gritavam: "Bendito é o Rei que vem em nome do Senhor! Paz no céu, e glória nas alturas!"
pt.R: Jesus chegou perto do lugar onde a estrada desce do monte das Oliveiras para Jerusalém. Ali toda a multidão dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores começou a louvar a Deus. Eles estavam cheios de alegria e gritavam bem alto, agradecendo a Deus por todos os milagres que tinham visto. \v 38 Eles diziam: "Que Deus abençoe o Rei que vem em nome do Senhor! Há paz no céu, e glória a Deus no mais alto dos céus!"

am.L: አሁንም ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ቁልቁለት በቀረበ ጊዜ የደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብዛት ሁሉ ስላዩአቸው የኃይል ሥራዎች ሁሉ ደስ እያላቸው በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ጀመር፤ \v 38 እንዲህም አሉ፦ «በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ [ነው]! በሰማይ ሰላም፣ በአርያምም ክብር!»
am.B: ከደብረ ዘይት ወደ ከተማዪቱ የሚወርደው መንገድ ወደሚጀምርበት ስፍራ በቀረበ ጊዜ የደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብዛት ሁሉ ስላዩአቸው ታላላቅ ሥራዎች ሁሉ በደስታና በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ማመስገን ጀመሩ። \v 38 እንዲህም እያሉ ጮኹ፦ «በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው! በሰማይ ሰላም፣ በአርያምም ክብር ይሁን!»
am.R: ኢየሱስ ከደብረ ዘይት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም የሚወርደው መንገድ ወደሚጀምርበት ስፍራ ቀረበ። በዚያም የተከተሉት ደቀ መዛሙርት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ማመስገን ጀመሩ። በደስታ ተሞልተው ስላዩአቸው ተአምራት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገን በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኹ። \v 38 እንዲህም አሉ፦ «በጌታ ስም የሚመጣውን ንጉሥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርከው! በሰማይ ሰላም አለ፤ ከሁሉ በላይ በሰማይ ላለው አምላክም ክብር ይሁን!»

ru.L: Когда же {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} уже приближался к спуску с Масличной горы, всё множество учеников, радуясь, начало громким голосом хвалить Бога за все дела силы, которые они видели, \v 38 говоря: «Благословен Царь, идущий во имя Господа! На небе мир, и слава в вышних!»
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} подошёл к месту, где дорога спускается с Масличной горы, всё множество {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} учеников начало радостно и громко славить Бога за все великие дела, которые они видели. \v 38 Они восклицали: «Благословен Царь, который приходит во имя Господа! Мир на небе и слава в высоте небес!»
ru.R: Иисус подошёл к месту, где дорога спускается с Масличной горы к Иерусалиму. Там всё множество {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} учеников начало славить Бога. Они были полны радости и громко благодарили Бога за все чудеса, которые видели. \v 38 Они говорили: «Пусть Бог благословит Царя, который приходит во имя Господа! На небе мир, и слава Богу на небесах!»

hi.L: और जब वे जैतून पहाड़ की ढलान के पास पहुँच ही रहे थे, तो चेलों की सारी भीड़ उन सब सामर्थ्य के कामों के कारण जो उन्होंने देखे थे, आनंदित होकर ऊँचे शब्द से परमेश्वर की स्तुति करने लगी, \v 38 और कहने लगी, "धन्य [है] वह राजा जो प्रभु के नाम से आता है! स्वर्ग में शान्ति, और सबसे ऊँचे स्थानों में महिमा!"
hi.B: जब वे नगर के पास पहुँचे, जहाँ सड़क जैतून पहाड़ से नीचे उतरती है, तो उनके चेलों की सारी भीड़ उन सब सामर्थ्य के कामों के लिए, जो उन्होंने देखे थे, आनंद से भरकर ऊँची आवाज़ में परमेश्वर की स्तुति करने लगी। \v 38 वे पुकार रहे थे, "धन्य है वह राजा जो प्रभु के नाम से आता है! स्वर्ग में शान्ति, और सबसे ऊँचे स्वर्ग में महिमा!"
hi.R: यीशु उस जगह के पास आए जहाँ सड़क जैतून पहाड़ से नीचे यरूशलेम की ओर उतरती है। वहाँ उनके चेलों की सारी भीड़ परमेश्वर की स्तुति करने लगी। वे आनंद से भरे हुए थे, और उन्होंने उन सब चमत्कारों के लिए, जो उन्होंने देखे थे, ऊँची आवाज़ में परमेश्वर को धन्यवाद दिया। \v 38 वे कह रहे थे, "परमेश्वर उस राजा को आशीष दे जो प्रभु के नाम से आता है! स्वर्ग में शान्ति है, और सबसे ऊँचे स्वर्ग में परमेश्वर की महिमा हो!"

uk.L: Коли ж {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уже наближався до спуску з Оливної гори, уся сила учнів почала, радіючи, хвалити Бога гучним голосом за всі чуда, які бачили, \v 38 кажучи: «Благословенний Цар, що йде в імʼя Господнє! На небі мир і слава на висотах!»
uk.B: Коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наблизився до міста, там, де дорога спускається з Оливної гори, увесь гурт {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} учнів почав радісно й гучно хвалити Бога за всі чуда, які вони бачили. \v 38 Вони вигукували: «Благословенний Цар, що йде в імʼя Господнє! Мир на небі й слава на висотах!»
uk.R: Ісус підійшов до того місця, де дорога спускається з Оливної гори до Єрусалима. Там увесь великий гурт {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} учнів почав хвалити Бога. Вони дуже раділи й голосно дякували Богові за всі чуда, які бачили. \v 38 Вони казали: «Благословенний Цар, що йде в імʼя Господнє! На небі мир, і слава Богові на найвищому небі!»

ja.L: そして[イエスが]すでにオリーブ山の下り坂に近づかれたとき、弟子たちの群れは皆、喜んで、自分たちが見たすべての力あるわざのことで、大声で神を賛美し始めて、\v 38 言った。「主の名において来られる王は祝福されている！天には平和、そして最も高い所には栄光！」
ja.B: イエスがオリーブ山の下り坂にさしかかられると、弟子たちの群れはこぞって、自分たちが見たあらゆる力あるわざのことで、喜びにあふれ、大声で神を賛美し始めた。\v 38 彼らは叫んだ。「主の名によって来られる王に、神の祝福を！天には平和、天の高い所には栄光！」
ja.R: イエスは、オリーブ山からエルサレムへ下る道の近くまで来られました。そこで、イエスについて来た大勢の弟子たちは、みな神を賛美し始めました。彼らは喜びにあふれて、自分たちが見たすべての奇跡のことで、大きな声で神に感謝しました。\v 38 彼らは言いました。「主に遣わされて来られる王を、神が祝福してくださるように！天には平和があり、いちばん高い天におられる神に栄光があるように！」

decisions.choice: Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord: Psalm 118:26, with "the King" added; in the Hebrew, "Lord" is the divine name
decisions.reason: Psalm 118 was sung by pilgrims at the great festivals. Its verse 26 blesses the one who comes in the name of the LORD; the disciples add "the King". Jesus himself quoted the verse in 13:35. To come in the Lord's name is to come sent by God and with his authority.

decisions.choice: blessed: praised, spoken well of before God
decisions.reason: This is not the word of the beatitudes (6:20-22), which says someone is fortunate, but the word used for praising God (1:68) and for those on whom God's blessing rests (1:42).

decisions.choice: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest: peace with God is settled in heaven, and God is praised there
alternatives: a wish: let there be peace in heaven
decisions.reason: The words echo the angels' song at Jesus' birth: glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace (2:14). Here the disciples speak of peace in heaven. God has made peace through the king who comes, and heaven gives him the glory. Luke does not have the cry "Hosanna" found in the other Gospels.

decisions.choice: works of power: miracles
decisions.reason: As in 10:13, the word means acts that show power.

decisions.choice: the descent of the Mount of Olives: where the road from Bethany crests the hill and Jerusalem comes into view
decisions.reason: From the top of the Mount of Olives the road goes down toward the city, which lies across the valley in full view (19:41).

decisions.choice: the whole multitude of the disciples: the large company of his followers, not only the twelve
decisions.reason: Luke speaks of a great company of disciples (6:17). These, not the city crowd, praise him; the Pharisees ask him to silence his disciples (19:39).

decisions.choice: peace; glory (every level)
decisions.reason: Key terms keep the same words at every level.

decisions.choice: There is peace in heaven; glory to God in the highest heaven
alternatives: Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest
decisions.reason: Readable makes a sentence of the first cry and names God as the one given glory, as in 2:14 (m3).

decisions.choice: the Lord
decisions.reason: As at John 1:23: in the New Testament the Greek word "Lord" is rendered "Lord"; meaning decision m1 notes that the Hebrew of Psalm 118 has the divine name.

decisions.choice: mighty deeds (B); miracles (R)
decisions.reason: As in 10:13.

decisions.choice: obras poderosas (L, B); milagros (R)
decisions.reason: The term used through the Gospels for these works of power (meaning decision m4); Readable says "milagros", as the English Readable says "miracles".

decisions.choice: dans les lieux très hauts (L); au plus haut des cieux (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "in the highest [places]", meaning heaven (m3). Literal keeps the plural place-word, as in Mark 11:10; Balanced and Readable say plainly that it is the highest heaven.

decisions.choice: matendo ya nguvu (L, B); miujiza (R)
decisions.reason: The term used through the Gospels for these works of power (meaning decision m4); Readable says "miujiza", as the English Readable says "miracles".

decisions.choice: "Đáng chúc tụng [thay] ... trong danh [của] Chúa" (L); "Chúc tụng ... trong danh Chúa" (B); "Cầu Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho ..." (R); "nơi chí cao" (L), "các tầng trời cao nhất" (B), "trời cao nhất" (R); "Vua" capitalised
decisions.reason: The same wording as the Vietnamese Mark 11:9-10 and Luke 13:35, with Luke's "the King" added. "Chúa" with no divine-name setting, as the Greek has kyrios (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "bình an" and "vinh quang" at every level
decisions.reason: Key terms of the style guide, kept the same at every level.

decisions.choice: "việc quyền năng" (L, B); "phép lạ" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the common word for miracles, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "주님의 이름으로 오시는 왕께 복이 있기를!" (L, B); "주님께서 보내셔서 오시는 왕께 하나님께서 복을 주시기를!" (R); "주님" with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Luke 13:35 and Mark 11:9, with "왕" added as Luke has it.

decisions.choice: "능력 있는 일" (L, B), "기적" (R) for dynameis; "평안" and "영광" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 10:13 and 2:14; "평안" and "영광" are key terms.

decisions.choice: Bendito (L, B); Que Deus abençoe (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 21:9 and Mark 11:9 in Portuguese: "bendito" is the word for one praised before God (m2), and Readable says the blessing as a wish addressed to God, which is how a Brazilian reader hears it.

decisions.choice: "በአርያም" (in the highest, L, B); "ከሁሉ በላይ በሰማይ" (highest in heaven, R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 21:9: "አርያም" is the living church word for the highest heaven, known from worship; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Благословен ... идущий" (L); "который приходит" (B, R); "в вышних" (L); "в высоте небес" (B); "Богу на небесах" (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as the crowd's cry in Mark 11:9-10 and Matthew 21:9 at each level, with Luke's "Царь" added; "мир" and "слава" stay as key terms.

decisions.choice: "धन्य [है] वह राजा जो प्रभु के नाम से आता है" (L, B); "परमेश्वर उस राजा को आशीष दे ..." (R)
decisions.reason: The psalm is worded as in Mark 11:9 and Matthew 21:9, with Luke's "the King" added (meaning decision m1). The one who comes is spoken of with plain forms, as in the psalm.

decisions.choice: "शान्ति"; "महिमा" (every level)
decisions.reason: Key terms keep the same word at every level, as the style guide has them.

decisions.choice: "уся сила учнів" (L); "увесь гурт учнів" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Сила" in the sense of "a great many" keeps the Greek's "multitude" at Literal; Balanced and Readable use "гурт", a company of followers. Readable keeps "учні" where the English says "followers".

decisions.choice: "祝福されている" (L); "神の祝福を" (B); "神が祝福してくださるように" (R), with "王" added to the wording of Mark 11:9 in Japanese
decisions.reason: This is the word for praising God and for God's blessing, not the word of the beatitudes (m2), so it is not "幸い". The cry keeps the Japanese of Psalm 118:26 in Mark 11:9, with "the King" that Luke's disciples add (m1). "平和" and "栄光" stay the same at every level, and "最も高い所" (L) and "天の高い所" (B) follow the angels' song at 2:14 (m3).

decisions.choice: "弟子たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "followers"; the Japanese keeps "弟子たち" at every level, as for all the Gospels, and makes clear by "大勢" that more than the twelve are meant (m6).

source.text: καί τινες τῶν Φαρισαίων ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν· Διδάσκαλε, ἐπιτίμησον τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου.

records.literal_gloss: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to him, Teacher, rebuke the disciples of you.

en.L: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, rebuke {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} disciples!"
en.B: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, tell {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} disciples to stop!"
en.R: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} followers be quiet!"

es.L: Y algunos de los fariseos de entre la multitud {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Maestro, reprende a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} discípulos».
es.B: Algunos fariseos que estaban entre la multitud {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Maestro, ¡di a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} discípulos que paren!».
es.R: Algunos de los fariseos que estaban entre la gente le dijeron a Jesús: «Maestro, ¡haz que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} discípulos se callen!».

fr.L: Et quelques-uns des Pharisiens, du milieu de la foule, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Maître, réprimande {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} disciples ! »
fr.B: Quelques Pharisiens qui étaient dans la foule {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Maître, dis à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} disciples de se taire ! »
fr.R: Quelques Pharisiens qui étaient dans la foule ont dit à Jésus : « Maître, oblige {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} disciples à se taire ! »

sw.L: Na baadhi ya Mafarisayo kutoka katika umati wakamwambia, "Mwalimu, wakemee wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}!"
sw.B: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwa katika umati walimwambia, "Mwalimu, waambie wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waache!"
sw.R: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwa katika umati walimwambia Yesu, "Mwalimu, wanyamazishe wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}!"

vi.L: Và mấy người Pha-ri-si trong đám đông nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, hãy quở trách các môn đồ của Thầy!"
vi.B: Mấy người Pha-ri-si trong đám đông nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, xin bảo các môn đồ của Thầy im đi!"
vi.R: Có mấy người Pha-ri-si ở trong đám đông nói với Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Thầy, hãy bắt các môn đồ của Thầy im lặng!"

ko.L: 그런데 무리 가운데 있던 바리새파 사람들 몇이 그분께 말했다. "선생님, 선생님의 제자들을 꾸짖으십시오."
ko.B: 무리 가운데 있던 몇몇 바리새파 사람이 예수께 말했다. "선생님, 선생님의 제자들을 조용히 시키십시오!"
ko.R: 무리 가운데 있던 바리새파 사람 몇이 예수께 말했다. "선생님, 선생님의 제자들이 조용히 하도록 하십시오!"

pt.L: E alguns dos fariseus que estavam na multidão {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disseram: "Mestre, repreende os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} discípulos!"
pt.B: Alguns fariseus que estavam na multidão {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disseram: "Mestre, ordena aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} discípulos que parem!"
pt.R: Alguns dos fariseus que estavam na multidão disseram a Jesus: "Mestre, manda os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} seguidores ficarem calados!"

am.L: ከሕዝቡም መካከል አንዳንድ ፈሪሳውያን፦ «መምህር ሆይ፣ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ገሥጻቸው!» አሉት።
am.B: በሕዝቡ መካከል የነበሩ አንዳንድ ፈሪሳውያን «መምህር ሆይ፣ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ዝም እንዲሉ ንገራቸው!» አሉት።
am.R: በሕዝቡ መካከል የነበሩ አንዳንድ ፈሪሳውያን ኢየሱስን «መምህር ሆይ፣ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ዝም አሰኛቸው!» አሉት።

ru.L: И некоторые фарисеи из толпы сказали {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Учитель, запрети своим ученикам!»
ru.B: Некоторые фарисеи в толпе сказали {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Учитель, вели своим ученикам замолчать!»
ru.R: Некоторые фарисеи в толпе сказали Иисусу: «Учитель, заставь своих учеников замолчать!»

hi.L: और भीड़ में से कुछ फ़रीसियों ने उनसे कहा, "हे गुरु, अपने चेलों को डाँटिए!"
hi.B: भीड़ में से कुछ फ़रीसियों ने उनसे कहा, "हे गुरु, अपने चेलों से कहिए कि रुक जाएँ!"
hi.R: भीड़ में से कुछ फ़रीसियों ने यीशु से कहा, "हे गुरु, अपने चेलों को चुप कराइए!"

uk.L: І деякі фарисеї з натовпу сказали до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}: «Учителю, докори своїм учням!»
uk.B: Деякі фарисеї з натовпу сказали {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Учителю, накажи своїм учням замовкнути!»
uk.R: Деякі фарисеї в натовпі сказали Ісусові: «Учителю, зроби так, щоб {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} учні замовкли!»

ja.L: すると、群衆の中から、ファリサイ派の人々のある者たちがイエスに言った。「先生、あなたの弟子たちを叱りなさい。」
ja.B: 群衆の中にいたファリサイ派の人々の何人かが、イエスに言った。「先生、弟子たちをやめさせなさい。」
ja.R: 群衆の中にいたファリサイ派の人たちの何人かが、イエスに言いました。「先生、弟子たちを黙らせなさい！」

decisions.choice: Pharisees: a Jewish movement devoted to keeping God's law in every part of life
decisions.reason: As explained at 5:17. This is the last time Luke's Gospel mentions them. They object to the disciples hailing Jesus as king, perhaps fearing the Roman governor's response, or because they reject the claim.

decisions.choice: rebuke: order to stop, correct sternly
decisions.reason: The word is used for a sharp command to stop (9:21, 42; 18:15, 39).

decisions.choice: Teacher: a respectful title, but no more
decisions.reason: The Pharisees call him teacher while the disciples call him king (7:40).

decisions.choice: tell your disciples to stop (B); make your followers be quiet (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the rebuke would do (m2).

decisions.choice: Maître
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:14: "Maître" is how French addresses a respected teacher; "Enseignant" and "Professeur" are job titles and sound like school.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy" and "Thầy" for "your", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: "Thầy" is a noun of address, always capitalised (style guide section 7); the Pharisees use the respectful title and no more (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: The Pharisees speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "선생님" for the title and for "your"
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 13:31.

decisions.choice: "꾸짖다" (L); "조용히 시키다" (B, R) for epitimao
decisions.reason: Here the rebuke is an order to stop (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: tu (repreende, ordena, manda, teus)
decisions.reason: The Pharisees speak to Jesus, so they use "tu" (style §4), as his opponents do throughout; their tone shows in what they ask, not in the form of address.

decisions.choice: "своим ученикам", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has a span on "your"; after a command Russian uses the reflexive "свой", which takes none.

decisions.choice: "हे गुरु", "डाँटिए" (respectful)
decisions.reason: Even his opponents address Jesus with "आप" forms, as the style guide has it; "गुरु" is the book's word for "Teacher".

decisions.choice: "叱りなさい", "やめさせなさい", "黙らせなさい" (plain commands)
decisions.reason: The Pharisees give Jesus a title of respect and no more (m3), and they speak as opponents giving an order, so the command is plain rather than a polite request.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἐὰν οὗτοι σιωπήσουσιν, οἱ λίθοι κράξουσιν.

records.literal_gloss: And answering he said, I say to you, that if these will be silent, the stones will cry out.

en.L: And answering, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "I tell you that if these keep silent, the stones will cry out."
en.B: He answered, "I tell you, if these people were silent, the very stones would shout."
en.R: Jesus answered, "I tell you, if my followers stopped praising, the stones themselves would start shouting!"

es.L: Y respondiendo, dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que si estos callan, las piedras gritarán».
es.B: Él respondió: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que, si estos se callaran, gritarían las mismas piedras».
es.R: Jesús respondió: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que, si los discípulos dejaran de alabar, ¡las piedras mismas se pondrían a gritar!».

fr.L: Et, répondant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Je vous dis que, si ceux-ci se taisent, les pierres crieront. »
fr.B: Il répondit : « Je vous le dis : si eux se taisaient, ce sont les pierres qui crieraient. »
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Je vous le dis : si mes disciples arrêtaient de louer Dieu, les pierres elles-mêmes se mettraient à crier ! »

sw.L: Naye akajibu akasema, "Nawaambia kwamba hawa wakinyamaza, mawe yatapiga kelele."
sw.B: Akajibu, "Nawaambia, kama watu hawa wangenyamaza, mawe yenyewe yangepiga kelele."
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Nawaambia, kama wanafunzi wangeacha kusifu, mawe yenyewe yangeanza kupiga kelele!"

vi.L: Và đáp lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Ta nói với các người rằng nếu những người này im lặng, thì các hòn đá sẽ kêu lên."
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Ta nói cho các người biết, nếu những người này im lặng, thì chính các hòn đá sẽ reo lên."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta nói cho các người biết, nếu các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thôi ca ngợi, thì chính các hòn đá sẽ bắt đầu reo hò!"

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 대답하여 말씀하셨다. "내가 너희에게 말한다. 이 사람들이 잠잠하면, 돌들이 소리 지를 것이다."
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 너희에게 말한다. 이 사람들이 잠잠하면, 돌들이라도 소리를 지를 것이다."
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 너희에게 말한다. 내 제자들이 찬양을 멈추면, 돌들이 소리치기 시작할 것이다!"

pt.L: E, respondendo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "Eu lhes digo que, se estes se calarem, as pedras gritarão."
pt.B: Ele respondeu: "Eu lhes digo: se estes se calassem, as próprias pedras clamariam."
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "Eu digo a vocês: se os meus seguidores parassem de louvar, as próprias pedras começariam a gritar!"

am.L: መልሶም እንዲህ አለ፦ «እላችኋለሁ፣ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮቹ ይጮኻሉ።»
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ፦ «እላችኋለሁ፣ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮች እንኳ ይጮኻሉ።»
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ፦ «እላችኋለሁ፣ ደቀ መዛሙርቴ ማመስገናቸውን ቢያቆሙ ድንጋዮቹ ራሳቸው መጮኽ ይጀምራሉ!»

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал в ответ: «Говорю вам, что если они замолчат, камни закричат.»
ru.B: Он ответил: «Говорю вам: если они умолкнут, то закричат сами камни.»
ru.R: Иисус ответил: «Говорю вам: если {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} ученики перестанут славить Бога, то сами камни начнут кричать!»

hi.L: उन्होंने उत्तर में कहा, "मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ कि यदि ये चुप रहेंगे, तो पत्थर चिल्ला उठेंगे।"
hi.B: उन्होंने उत्तर दिया, "मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, यदि ये लोग चुप हो जाएँ, तो पत्थर ही पुकार उठेंगे।"
hi.R: यीशु ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, अगर मेरे चेले स्तुति करना बंद कर दें, तो पत्थर ख़ुद चिल्लाने लगेंगे!"

uk.L: І, відповідаючи, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав: «Кажу вам, що коли ці замовкнуть, камені кричатимуть.»
uk.B: Він відповів: «Кажу вам: якби ці замовкли, то закричало б саме каміння.»
uk.R: Ісус відповів: «Кажу вам: якби {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} учні перестали хвалити Бога, то саме каміння почало б кричати!»

ja.L: すると[イエスは]答えて言われた。「あなたがたに言う。もしこの者たちが黙れば、石が叫ぶであろう。」
ja.B: イエスはお答えになった。「あなたがたに言っておく。もしこの人たちが黙れば、石が叫びだす。」
ja.R: イエスはお答えになりました。「言っておく。もしわたしの弟子たちが賛美するのをやめたら、石が叫びだすだろう！」

decisions.choice: the stones will cry out: the praise cannot be stopped; creation itself would give it
alternatives: the stones will cry out against Jerusalem in judgment
decisions.reason: The saying is a vivid way of saying that this moment must be greeted with praise. Habakkuk 2:11 speaks of a stone crying out from the wall against wrongdoing, which some hear here as a hint of judgment, and stones appear again in 19:44.

decisions.choice: if these will be silent: the future tense after "if" pictures a real possibility
alternatives: if these were to be silent
decisions.reason: The construction is unusual. The sense is the same: should the disciples be silent.

decisions.choice: that: introduces what Jesus says
decisions.reason: The word marks the start of the statement after "I tell you".

decisions.choice: would shout (B); would start shouting (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the case as a supposition, which fits the sense (m2).

decisions.choice: my followers stopped praising
decisions.reason: Readable says who "these" are and what they would stop doing.

decisions.choice: "các người" for Jesus addressing the Pharisees
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to opponents.

decisions.choice: "내가 너희에게 말한다" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 7:9.

source.text: Καὶ ὡς ἤγγισεν, ἰδὼν τὴν πόλιν ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ’ αὐτήν, λέγων ὅτι Εἰ ἔγνως ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ καὶ σὺ τὰ πρὸς εἰρήνην νῦν δὲ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ ὀφθαλμῶν σου.

records.literal_gloss: And as he drew near, having seen the city he wept over it, \v 42 saying that If you had known in the day this even you the [things] for peace; but now it was hidden from eyes of you.

en.L: And as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drew near, seeing the city, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wept over it, \v 42 saying, "If you, even you, had known on this day the things that make for peace! But now they have been hidden from your eyes.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came nearer and saw the city, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wept over it. \v 42 "If only you too had known on this day the things that lead to peace!" {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said. "But now they are hidden from your sight.
en.R: As Jesus came closer to Jerusalem, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the city, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cried over it. \v 42 He said, "Jerusalem, I wish that today you had understood what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from you, and you cannot see it.

es.L: Y cuando se acercó, al ver la ciudad, lloró por ella, \v 42 diciendo: «¡Si tú, aun tú, hubieras conocido en este día lo que conduce a la paz! Pero ahora ha quedado oculto a tus ojos.
es.B: Cuando se acercó más y vio la ciudad, lloró por ella. \v 42 «¡Si también tú hubieras reconocido en este día lo que lleva a la paz! —dijo—. Pero ahora está oculto a tus ojos.
es.R: Cuando Jesús se acercó más a Jerusalén, vio la ciudad y lloró por ella. \v 42 Dijo: «Jerusalén, ¡cómo quisiera que hoy hubieras entendido lo que te traería la paz! Pero ahora eso está escondido de ti, y no lo puedes ver.

fr.L: Et comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} approchait, voyant la ville, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pleura sur elle, \v 42 disant : « Si toi aussi tu avais connu, en ce jour, les choses [qui mènent] à la paix ! Mais maintenant elles ont été cachées à tes yeux.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut plus près et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit la ville, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pleura sur elle. \v 42 « Si seulement toi aussi tu avais reconnu en ce jour ce qui conduit à la paix ! dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}. Mais maintenant, cela est caché à tes yeux.
fr.R: Quand Jésus s’est approché de Jérusalem, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu la ville et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a pleuré sur elle. \v 42 Il a dit : « Jérusalem, si seulement tu avais compris aujourd’hui ce qui t’apporterait la paix ! Mais maintenant, c’est caché pour toi, et tu ne peux pas le voir.

sw.L: Na alipokaribia, akiuona mji, aliulilia, \v 42 akisema, "Laiti ungalijua katika siku hii, hata wewe, mambo ya amani! Lakini sasa yamefichwa machoni pako.
sw.B: Alipokaribia zaidi na kuuona mji, aliulilia. \v 42 Akasema, "Laiti wewe nawe ungalitambua katika siku hii mambo yaletayo amani! Lakini sasa yamefichwa usiyaone.
sw.R: Yesu alipokaribia Yerusalemu, aliuona mji, akaulilia. \v 42 Akasema, "Ee Yerusalemu, natamani leo ungekuwa umeelewa kile ambacho kingekuletea amani! Lakini sasa kimefichwa kwako, nawe huwezi kukiona.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần, thấy thành, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khóc về thành ấy, \v 42 nói rằng: "Ước gì ngươi, chính ngươi, đã biết trong ngày này những điều đem lại bình an! Nhưng bây giờ những điều ấy đã bị giấu khỏi mắt ngươi.
vi.B: Khi đến gần hơn và thấy thành, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khóc thương thành ấy. \v 42 Ngài nói: "Ước gì hôm nay chính ngươi cũng biết được những điều đem lại bình an cho mình! Nhưng bây giờ những điều ấy đã bị che khuất khỏi mắt ngươi.
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu đến gần Giê-ru-sa-lem, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhìn thấy thành và khóc thương thành ấy. \v 42 Ngài nói: "Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, ước gì hôm nay ngươi đã hiểu điều gì sẽ đem lại bình an cho ngươi! Nhưng bây giờ điều ấy đã bị che giấu khỏi ngươi, và ngươi không thể thấy được.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 가까이 오셔서 그 성을 보시고, 그 성을 두고 우시며 \v 42 말씀하셨다. "너도 오늘 이날에 평안에 이르는 일들을 알았더라면! 그러나 지금 그것들이 네 눈에서 숨겨졌다.
ko.B: 예수께서 성 가까이 오셔서 그 성을 보시고 우시며 \v 42 말씀하셨다. "너도 오늘 평안을 가져다줄 일을 알았더라면 좋았을 것을! 그러나 지금 그 일이 네 눈에 감추어져 있다.
ko.R: 예수께서 예루살렘 가까이 오셔서 그 도시를 보셨다. 그리고 그 도시를 두고 소리 내어 우셨다. \v 42 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "예루살렘아, 네가 오늘 너에게 평안을 가져다줄 일을 깨달았더라면 얼마나 좋았겠느냐! 그러나 이제 그 일이 너에게 감추어져서 네가 볼 수 없구나.

pt.L: E, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se aproximou, vendo a cidade, chorou sobre ela, \v 42 dizendo: "Se você, até você, tivesse conhecido neste dia o que [leva] à paz! Mas agora isso foi escondido dos seus olhos.
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} chegou mais perto e viu a cidade, chorou por ela. \v 42 "Ah, se também você tivesse reconhecido neste dia o que leva à paz!", disse {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. "Mas agora isso está escondido dos seus olhos.
pt.R: Quando Jesus chegou mais perto de Jerusalém e viu a cidade, chorou por ela. \v 42 Ele disse: "Jerusalém, como eu queria que hoje você tivesse entendido o que lhe traria paz! Mas agora isso está escondido de você, e você não consegue ver.

am.L: በቀረበም ጊዜ ከተማዪቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት፤ \v 42 እንዲህም አለ፦ «አንቺ ደግሞ በዚህች ቀን ለሰላም የሚሆነውን ብታውቂ ኖሮ! አሁን ግን ከዓይኖችሽ ተሰወረ።
am.B: በቀረበ ጊዜም ከተማዪቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት። \v 42 «አንቺም ብትሆኚ በዚህች ቀን ወደ ሰላም የሚያደርስሽን ብታውቂ ምንኛ መልካም ነበር!» አለ። «አሁን ግን ከዓይንሽ ተሰውሯል።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይበልጥ በቀረበ ጊዜ ከተማዪቱን አየ፤ ስለ እርሷም አለቀሰ። \v 42 እንዲህም አለ፦ «ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፣ ምነው ዛሬ ሰላም የሚያመጣልሽን ነገር ብታስተውዪ ኖሮ! አሁን ግን ተሰውሮብሻል፤ ልታዪውም አትችዪም።

ru.L: И когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} приблизился, увидев город, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заплакал о нём, \v 42 говоря: «О, если бы ты, даже ты, узнал в этот день то, что ведёт к миру! Но теперь это скрыто от твоих глаз.
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} подошёл ближе и увидел город, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заплакал о нём. \v 42 «Если бы и ты в этот день понял, что ведёт к миру!» — сказал {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}. — «Но теперь это скрыто от твоих глаз.
ru.R: Когда Иисус подошёл ближе к Иерусалиму, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел город и заплакал о нём. \v 42 Он сказал: «Иерусалим, как бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хотел, чтобы ты сегодня понял, что принесёт тебе мир! Но теперь это скрыто от тебя, и ты не можешь этого увидеть.

hi.L: और जब वे निकट आए, तो नगर को देखकर उस पर रोए, \v 42 और कहा, "यदि तुम, हाँ तुम भी, आज के दिन वे बातें जानतीं जो शान्ति की ओर ले जाती हैं! पर अब वे तुम्हारी आँखों से छिपा दी गई हैं।
hi.B: जब वे और पास आए और नगर को देखा, तो वे उस पर रो पड़े। \v 42 "काश, तुम भी आज के दिन वे बातें पहचान लेतीं जो शान्ति की ओर ले जाती हैं!" उन्होंने कहा। "पर अब वे तुम्हारी नज़रों से छिपी हैं।
hi.R: जब यीशु यरूशलेम के और पास आए, तो उन्होंने नगर को देखा, और वे उस पर रोने लगे। \v 42 उन्होंने कहा, "हे यरूशलेम, काश आज तुमने समझ लिया होता कि किस बात से तुम्हें शान्ति मिलेगी! पर अब वह तुमसे छिपी है, और तुम उसे देख नहीं सकतीं।

uk.L: І коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наблизився, побачивши місто, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} заплакав над ним, \v 42 кажучи: «Якби ж ти, навіть ти, пізнало цього дня те, що [веде] до миру! А тепер це сховане від твоїх очей.
uk.B: Коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підійшов ближче й побачив місто, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} заплакав над ним. \v 42 «Якби ж і ти пізнало цього дня, що веде до миру!» — сказав {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}. — «Але тепер це сховане від твоїх очей.
uk.R: Коли Ісус підійшов ближче до Єрусалима, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив місто й заплакав над ним. \v 42 Він сказав: «Єрусалиме, як би {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хотів, щоб сьогодні ти зрозумів, що принесе тобі мир! Але тепер це сховане від тебе, і ти не можеш цього бачити.

ja.L: そして[イエスは]近づいて、都を見ると、そのために泣いて、\v 42 言われた。「もしこの日に、おまえもまた、平和に至ることを知っていたなら……。しかし今、それはおまえの目から隠されてしまった。
ja.B: イエスは都に近づき、それをご覧になると、そのために泣かれた。\v 42 「この日に、おまえも平和への道をわきまえていたら、どんなによかったことか」とイエスは言われた。「しかし今は、それがおまえの目から隠されている。
ja.R: イエスはエルサレムに近づいて、都をご覧になると、そのために泣かれました。\v 42 イエスは言われました。「エルサレムよ、今日、何がおまえに平和をもたらすのか、おまえがわかっていたらよかったのに！しかし今、それはおまえから隠されていて、おまえには見えない。

decisions.choice: if you had known ...: a wish left unfinished, an expression of grief
alternatives: a condition with its result left out, "it would have saved you"
decisions.reason: The sentence begins as a condition and breaks off. It works as a cry of sorrow: if only you had known.

decisions.choice: the things for peace: what would bring peace with God and safety
alternatives: only a peace treaty with Rome
decisions.reason: The disciples have just sung of peace in heaven (19:38). Jerusalem's name was linked with peace (Hebrews 7:2; Psalm 122:6-8), but the city does not recognize the one who brings it. The war of 19:43-44 shows what follows.

decisions.choice: it was hidden: the way to peace is now hidden from the city
decisions.reason: The passive does not say who hid it. In Scripture God sometimes hides what people refuse to see (Isaiah 6:9-10; Luke 8:10; 18:34).

decisions.choice: wept: cried aloud
decisions.reason: The verb is used of loud weeping (6:21; 7:13; 8:52). Jesus grieves over the city that will reject him.

decisions.choice: on this day: the day the king comes to the city
decisions.reason: "This day" is the day of Jesus' coming; 19:44 calls it the time of the city's visitation.

decisions.choice: peace (every level)
decisions.reason: A key term (m2).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable names the city Jesus speaks to.

decisions.choice: Jesus' words open here and close at the end of 19:44
decisions.reason: The next sentence continues his words.

decisions.choice: Laiti ungalijua / ungalitambua
decisions.reason: The Greek "if" clause is a wish left unfinished, an expression of grief (meaning decision m1). "Laiti" is the Swahili word for such a wish (if only), so the sentence can stand without a second half; "kama" would leave the reader waiting for one.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" for the city addressed (19:42-44)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Jerusalem as in Luke 13:34-35, where the city is "các ngươi"; here the Greek is singular.

decisions.choice: "Ước gì" for the unfinished wish
decisions.reason: The Greek "if" clause has no second half (meaning decision); "Ước gì" is how Vietnamese says such a grieving wish.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks to the city as "너" in 해라체, through 19:44; "예루살렘아" (R)
decisions.reason: As he speaks to Jerusalem in the Korean Luke 13:34.

decisions.choice: "성" (L, B), "도시" (R) for polis, as in the Korean Mark 11:19; "평안" at every level
decisions.reason: "평안" is the key term; here it means peace with God and safety (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: você (Jesus to the city)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Jerusalem as to a person, with "você", as in Matthew 23:37 in Portuguese; "tu" is kept for words addressed to God and Jesus (style §4).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem addressed as "አንቺ" (you, feminine: "ብታውቂ", "ከዓይኖችሽ")
decisions.reason: Amharic speaks of a city as "she" and marks the gender of "you", so the city is spoken to in the feminine through 19:44, as in Matthew 23:37.

decisions.choice: "तुम" with feminine forms ("जानतीं", "सकतीं")
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the city as to a person, with "तुम" and feminine agreement, as in Matthew 23:37; the same holds through 19:44.

decisions.choice: "ти ... пізнало" (L, B), the neuter agreeing with "місто"; "Єрусалиме ... ти зрозумів" (R), agreeing with the name
decisions.reason: Ukrainian past tense shows gender: Jesus speaks to the city, and the verb agrees with the word for the city (neuter "місто") at Literal and Balanced; Readable names Jerusalem, a masculine noun, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "おまえ" for Jerusalem (19:42-44)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the city in grief and warning, as the prophets spoke to Jerusalem. "おまえ" is the form used for a city or a thing addressed directly (as the fig tree in Mark 11:14 in Japanese), and it keeps the singular of the Greek.

source.text: ὅτι ἥξουσιν ἡμέραι ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ ἐχθροί σου χάρακά σοι καὶ περικυκλώσουσίν σε καὶ συνέξουσίν σε πάντοθεν, καὶ ἐδαφιοῦσίν σε καὶ τὰ τέκνα σου ἐν σοί, καὶ οὐκ ἀφήσουσιν λίθον ἐπὶ λίθον ἐν σοί, ἀνθ’ ὧν οὐκ ἔγνως τὸν καιρὸν τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς σου.

records.literal_gloss: because will come days upon you and will throw up the enemies of you a palisade against you and will surround you and will hem in you from every side, \v 44 and will dash to the ground you and the children of you in you, and not will they leave stone upon stone in you, because not you knew the time of the visitation of you.

en.L: For days will come upon you when your enemies will set up a palisade against you and surround you and hem you in on every side, \v 44 and they will dash you to the ground, and your children within you, and they will not leave stone upon stone in you, because you did not know the time of your visitation."
en.B: For a time is coming for you when your enemies will build a siege wall against you. They will encircle you and press in on you from all sides. \v 44 They will level you to the ground, you and your children inside you. They will leave no stone on top of another within you, because you did not recognize the time when God came to visit you."
en.R: The time is coming when your enemies will build a wall around you. They will surround you and close in on you from every side. \v 44 They will destroy you completely, and they will kill the people who live inside your walls. They will not leave even one stone on top of another. This will happen because you did not understand that God had come to save you."

es.L: Porque vendrán días sobre ti en que tus enemigos levantarán contra ti una empalizada, y te rodearán, y te estrecharán por todas partes, \v 44 y te arrasarán hasta el suelo, a ti y a tus hijos dentro de ti, y no dejarán en ti piedra sobre piedra, porque no conociste el tiempo de tu visitación».
es.B: Porque vendrá un tiempo en que tus enemigos levantarán contra ti un cerco de asedio. Te rodearán y te apretarán por todos lados. \v 44 Te derribarán hasta el suelo, a ti y a tus hijos dentro de ti. No dejarán dentro de ti ni una piedra sobre otra, porque no reconociste el tiempo en que Dios vino a visitarte».
es.R: Llegará el día en que tus enemigos construirán un muro a tu alrededor. Te rodearán y te encerrarán por todos lados. \v 44 Te destruirán por completo y matarán a la gente que vive dentro de tus murallas. No dejarán ni una piedra encima de otra. Esto sucederá porque no entendiste que Dios había venido a salvarte».

fr.L: Car des jours viendront sur toi où tes ennemis élèveront contre toi une palissade, t’encercleront et te serreront de tous côtés ; \v 44 ils te jetteront à terre, toi et tes enfants au milieu de toi, et ils ne laisseront pas en toi pierre sur pierre, parce que tu n’as pas reconnu le temps de ta visitation. »
fr.B: Car un temps va venir pour toi où tes ennemis construiront contre toi un mur de siège. Ils t’encercleront et te presseront de tous côtés. \v 44 Ils te jetteront à terre, toi et tes enfants qui vivent dans tes murs. Ils ne laisseront pas chez toi une pierre sur une autre, parce que tu n’as pas reconnu le moment où Dieu est venu te visiter. »
fr.R: Le moment arrive où tes ennemis construiront un mur tout autour de toi. Ils t’encercleront et t’enfermeront de tous les côtés. \v 44 Ils te détruiront complètement, et ils tueront les gens qui vivent à l’intérieur de tes murs. Ils ne laisseront même pas une pierre sur une autre. Cela va arriver parce que tu n’as pas compris que Dieu était venu pour te sauver. »

sw.L: Kwa maana siku zitakujia ambapo adui zako watakujengea boma, na kukuzunguka, na kukubana pande zote, \v 44 nao watakuangusha chini, wewe na watoto wako walio ndani yako, wala hawataacha ndani yako jiwe juu ya jiwe, kwa sababu hukujua wakati wa kujiliwa kwako."
sw.B: Kwa maana wakati unakuja ambapo adui zako watajenga ukuta wa kukuzingira. Watakuzunguka na kukubana kila upande. \v 44 Watakusawazisha na ardhi, wewe na watoto wako walio ndani yako. Hawataacha jiwe juu ya jiwe jingine ndani yako, kwa sababu hukutambua wakati ambapo Mungu alikuja kukutembelea."
sw.R: Wakati unakuja ambapo adui zako watajenga ukuta kukuzunguka. Watakuzingira na kukubana kutoka kila upande. \v 44 Watakuangamiza kabisa, na kuwaua watu wanaoishi ndani ya kuta zako. Hawataacha hata jiwe moja juu ya jingine. Haya yatatokea kwa sababu hukuelewa kwamba Mungu alikuwa amekuja kukuokoa."

vi.L: Vì sẽ có những ngày đến trên ngươi, khi kẻ thù của ngươi sẽ đắp chiến lũy chống lại ngươi, bao vây ngươi và vây hãm ngươi từ mọi phía, \v 44 và sẽ san bằng ngươi xuống đất, cùng với con cái ngươi ở trong ngươi, và sẽ không để lại trong ngươi hòn đá nào trên hòn đá nào, vì ngươi đã không nhận biết thời điểm ngươi được thăm viếng."
vi.B: Vì sẽ đến lúc kẻ thù của ngươi đắp lũy bao vây ngươi. Chúng sẽ vây chặt ngươi và dồn ép ngươi từ mọi phía. \v 44 Chúng sẽ san bằng ngươi, ngươi và con cái ngươi ở trong thành. Chúng sẽ không để lại trong ngươi một hòn đá nào chồng trên một hòn đá khác, vì ngươi đã không nhận biết thời điểm Đức Chúa Trời đến thăm ngươi."
vi.R: Sẽ đến lúc kẻ thù của ngươi xây một bức tường bao quanh ngươi. Chúng sẽ vây ngươi và siết chặt ngươi từ mọi phía. \v 44 Chúng sẽ phá hủy ngươi hoàn toàn, và giết những người sống bên trong tường thành của ngươi. Chúng sẽ không để lại dù chỉ một hòn đá chồng lên hòn đá khác. Điều này sẽ xảy ra vì ngươi đã không hiểu rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã đến để cứu ngươi."

ko.L: 날들이 너에게 닥칠 것이기 때문이다. 그때 네 원수들이 너를 향하여 목책을 둘러치고, 너를 에워싸고, 사방에서 너를 조여 올 것이다. \v 44 그리고 너와 네 안에 있는 네 자녀들을 땅에 메어치고, 네 안에 돌 하나도 돌 위에 남겨 두지 않을 것이다. 네가 돌아보심을 받는 때를 알지 못하였기 때문이다."
ko.B: 날들이 너에게 닥쳐올 것이다. 그때 네 원수들이 너를 둘러 포위하는 벽을 쌓고, 너를 에워싸고, 사방에서 너를 조여 올 것이다. \v 44 그리고 너와 네 안에 있는 네 자녀들을 땅바닥에 메어칠 것이다. 네 안에 돌 하나도 다른 돌 위에 얹혀 있지 못하게 할 것이다. 하나님께서 너를 찾아오신 때를 네가 알아보지 못했기 때문이다."
ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. 그때 네 원수들이 네 둘레에 담을 쌓을 것이다. 그들은 너를 에워싸고 사방에서 조여 올 것이다. \v 44 그들은 너를 완전히 무너뜨리고, 네 성벽 안에 사는 사람들을 죽일 것이다. 돌 하나도 다른 돌 위에 남겨 두지 않을 것이다. 이 일은 하나님께서 너를 구원하시려고 오셨는데도 네가 그것을 깨닫지 못했기 때문에 일어날 것이다."

pt.L: Porque virão dias sobre você em que os seus inimigos levantarão uma paliçada contra você, e a cercarão, e a apertarão de todos os lados, \v 44 e a lançarão por terra, a você e aos seus filhos dentro de você, e não deixarão em você pedra sobre pedra, porque você não reconheceu o tempo da sua visitação."
pt.B: Pois virá para você um tempo em que os seus inimigos vão levantar contra você um muro de cerco. Eles vão cercá-la e apertá-la por todos os lados. \v 44 Vão derrubá-la por terra, junto com os seus filhos que estão dentro de você. Não vão deixar em você pedra sobre pedra, porque você não reconheceu o tempo em que Deus veio visitá-la."
pt.R: Vai chegar o tempo em que os seus inimigos vão construir um muro em volta de você. Eles vão cercar você e apertar você de todos os lados. \v 44 Vão destruir você completamente e matar as pessoas que moram dentro dos seus muros. Não vão deixar nem uma pedra em cima da outra. Isso vai acontecer porque você não entendeu que Deus tinha vindo para salvar você."

am.L: ጠላቶችሽ በዙሪያሽ ቅጥር የሚያቆሙብሽ፣ የሚከቡሽና በየአቅጣጫው የሚያስጨንቁሽ ቀኖች ይመጡብሻልና፤ \v 44 አንቺንና በውስጥሽ ያሉትን ልጆችሽን ከምድር ጋር ያደባልቃሉ፤ በውስጥሽም ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ አይተዉም፤ የመጎብኘትሽን ጊዜ አላወቅሽምና።»
am.B: ጠላቶችሽ በዙሪያሽ የከበባ ቅጥር የሚሠሩበት ጊዜ ይመጣብሻልና። ይከቡሻል፤ ከየአቅጣጫውም ያስጨንቁሻል። \v 44 አንቺንና በውስጥሽ ያሉትን ልጆችሽን ከምድር ጋር ያደባልቃሉ። እግዚአብሔር ሊጎበኝሽ የመጣበትን ጊዜ ስላላወቅሽ በውስጥሽ በሌላው ላይ የቆመ አንድም ድንጋይ አይተዉም።»
am.R: ጠላቶችሽ በዙሪያሽ ቅጥር የሚሠሩበት ጊዜ ይመጣል። ይከቡሻል፤ ከየአቅጣጫውም ያጣብቡሻል። \v 44 ፈጽመው ያጠፉሻል፤ በቅጥርሽ ውስጥ የሚኖሩትንም ሰዎች ይገድላሉ። በሌላ ድንጋይ ላይ የቆመ አንድም ድንጋይ አይተዉም። ይህ የሚሆነው እግዚአብሔር ሊያድንሽ እንደ መጣ ስላላስተዋልሽ ነው።»

ru.L: Ведь придут на тебя дни, когда твои враги поставят против тебя частокол, и окружат тебя, и стеснят тебя со всех сторон, \v 44 и сравняют с землёй тебя и твоих детей в тебе, и не оставят в тебе камня на камне, потому что ты не узнал времени твоего посещения.»
ru.B: Ведь настанет для тебя время, когда твои враги возведут вокруг тебя осадный вал. Они окружат тебя и стеснят со всех сторон. \v 44 Они сравняют с землёй тебя и твоих детей в тебе. Они не оставят в тебе камня на камне, потому что ты не узнал времени, когда Бог пришёл к тебе.»
ru.R: Наступит время, когда твои враги построят вокруг тебя стену. Они окружат тебя и будут теснить со всех сторон. \v 44 Они полностью разрушат тебя и убьют людей, которые живут в твоих стенах. Они не оставят даже камня на камне. Это случится потому, что ты не понял, что Бог пришёл спасти тебя.»

hi.L: क्योंकि तुम पर ऐसे दिन आएँगे जब तुम्हारे शत्रु तुम्हारे चारों ओर मोर्चे की बाड़ खड़ी करेंगे, और तुम्हें घेर लेंगे, और हर ओर से तुम्हें दबाएँगे, \v 44 और तुम्हें और तुम्हारे भीतर रहनेवाले तुम्हारे बच्चों को मिट्टी में मिला देंगे, और तुममें पत्थर पर पत्थर भी न छोड़ेंगे, क्योंकि तुमने उस समय को नहीं पहचाना जब तुम्हारी सुधि ली गई।"
hi.B: क्योंकि तुम पर ऐसा समय आनेवाला है जब तुम्हारे शत्रु तुम्हारे विरुद्ध घेराबंदी की दीवार खड़ी करेंगे। वे तुम्हें घेर लेंगे और हर ओर से तुम पर दबाव डालेंगे। \v 44 वे तुम्हें और तुम्हारे भीतर रहनेवाले तुम्हारे बच्चों को धूल में मिला देंगे। वे तुममें एक पत्थर पर दूसरा पत्थर भी नहीं छोड़ेंगे, क्योंकि तुमने उस समय को नहीं पहचाना जब परमेश्वर तुमसे मिलने आए।"
hi.R: ऐसा समय आ रहा है जब तुम्हारे शत्रु तुम्हारे चारों ओर एक दीवार बनाएँगे। वे तुम्हें घेर लेंगे और हर ओर से तुम पर टूट पड़ेंगे। \v 44 वे तुम्हें पूरी तरह नष्ट कर देंगे, और तुम्हारी दीवारों के भीतर रहनेवाले लोगों को मार डालेंगे। वे एक पत्थर पर दूसरा पत्थर भी नहीं छोड़ेंगे। यह इसलिए होगा कि तुमने यह नहीं समझा कि परमेश्वर तुम्हें बचाने आए थे।"

uk.L: Бо прийдуть на тебе дні, і твої вороги поставлять довкола тебе частокіл, і оточать тебе, і стиснуть тебе звідусіль, \v 44 і повалять на землю тебе й твоїх дітей у тобі, і не залишать у тобі каменя на камені, через те що ти не пізнало часу твоїх відвідин.»
uk.B: Бо настане для тебе час, коли твої вороги звалять довкола тебе облоговий вал. Вони оточать тебе й стиснуть звідусіль. \v 44 Вони зрівняють тебе із землею, тебе й твоїх дітей, що в тобі. Вони не залишать у тобі каменя на камені, бо ти не розпізнало часу, коли Бог прийшов відвідати тебе.»
uk.R: Настає час, коли твої вороги поставлять довкола тебе стіну. Вони оточать тебе й обступлять з усіх боків. \v 44 Вони зовсім знищать тебе й повбивають людей, які живуть у твоїх стінах. Вони не залишать жодного каменя на камені. Так станеться тому, що ти не зрозумів, що Бог прийшов тебе врятувати.»

ja.L: なぜなら、日々がおまえの上に来て、おまえの敵たちがおまえに対して柵を築き、おまえを取り囲み、四方からおまえを締めつけ、\v 44 おまえと、おまえの中にいるおまえの子らを地に打ちつけ、おまえの中に石の上に石を残さないからである。おまえが、[神の]訪れの時を知らなかったからである。」
ja.B: やがて時が来て、敵がおまえに対して包囲の土塁を築き、おまえを取り囲んで、四方から攻め立てる。\v 44 そして、おまえとその中にいるおまえの子らを地に打ち倒し、おまえの中に、積み重なった石を一つも残さないだろう。神がおまえを訪れてくださった時を、おまえがわきまえなかったからである。」
ja.R: 敵がおまえの周りに壁を築く時が来る。敵はおまえを取り囲み、四方から攻めて来る。\v 44 そして、おまえをすっかり滅ぼし、おまえの中に住む人々を殺してしまう。石を一つも積み重なったまま残さない。こうなるのは、神がおまえを救いに来られたのに、おまえがそれをわからなかったからだ。」

decisions.choice: palisade: a siege wall of stakes and earth built around a city
decisions.reason: Besiegers built such walls to cut a city off. In AD 70 the Roman army under Titus surrounded Jerusalem with a siege wall, took the city and destroyed the temple.

decisions.choice: dash you to the ground, and your children: the language of the prophets for a city's fall
decisions.reason: The words recall Isaiah 29:3 (the LORD will besiege Jerusalem with siegeworks), Psalm 137:9 and Hosea 10:14 (children dashed down). "Your children" means the city's people.

decisions.choice: the time of your visitation: the time when God came to you
decisions.reason: In the Old Testament God "visits" his people to help or to judge them. Zechariah praised God for visiting his people to redeem them (1:68, 78), and the crowd at Nain said God had visited his people (7:16). Jerusalem did not see that God had come to it in Jesus.

decisions.choice: not leave stone upon stone: destroy completely
alternatives: only the temple will be destroyed
decisions.reason: The city will be so ruined that its buildings fall stone from stone. Jesus says the same of the temple in 21:6.

decisions.choice: the time when God came to visit you (B); that God had come to save you (R)
decisions.reason: "Visitation" is no longer used in this sense. Balanced says who came; Readable says why he came, as in 1:68 and 7:16 (m3). Literal keeps "visitation".

decisions.choice: destroy you completely; kill the people who live inside your walls
alternatives: dash to the ground you and your children
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: una empalizada (L); un cerco de asedio (B); un muro (R)
decisions.reason: A palisade of stakes and earth built round a city under siege (meaning decision m1). Literal names the thing; Balanced says what it was for; Readable says "muro", as the English Readable says "wall".

decisions.choice: le temps de ta visitation (L); le moment où Dieu est venu te visiter (B); que Dieu était venu pour te sauver (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps "visitation", the word French Bibles have used for God coming to his people, though most readers now know it as the name of a Marian feast; "visite" would sound like a social call. Balanced says who came, and Readable why (m3).

decisions.choice: boma (L); ukuta wa kukuzingira (B); ukuta (R)
decisions.reason: A palisade of stakes and earth built round a city under siege (meaning decision m1). "Boma" is a fence or stockade of stakes; Balanced says what it was for, and Readable says "ukuta", as the English Readable says "wall". "Ngome" is a fortress, the city's own defence.

decisions.choice: "chiến lũy" (L); "lũy" (B); "bức tường" (R)
decisions.reason: A siege rampart of stakes and earth (meaning decision); Readable uses the plain word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "thời điểm ngươi được thăm viếng" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "visitation" without naming who visits; Balanced and Readable name God, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "목책" (L); "포위하는 벽" (B); "담" (R) for charax
decisions.reason: A siege wall of stakes and earth (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "돌아보심을 받는 때" (L); "하나님께서 너를 찾아오신 때" (B); "하나님께서 너를 구원하시려고 오셨는데도" (R) for episkope
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 1:68 and 7:16 for God's visiting ("돌아보다" at Literal); the honorific passive at Literal shows that God is the one who visits.

decisions.choice: "자녀들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자녀" already means sons and daughters.

decisions.choice: a cercarão, cercá-la (L, B); cercar você (R)
decisions.reason: The city is spoken to as "você" and is feminine ("a cidade"), so the object pronoun is "a" / "-la" in written Literal and Balanced; Readable puts "você" after the verb, as Brazilians say it.

decisions.choice: "जब तुम्हारी सुधि ली गई" (L)
decisions.reason: The time of visitation is the time God came to the city (meaning decision m3); "सुधि लेना", to come and look after someone, keeps the old word's sense at Literal. Balanced and Readable say who came, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "[神の]訪れの時" (L); "神がおまえを訪れてくださった時" (B); "神がおまえを救いに来られた" (R)
decisions.reason: "Visitation" means the time when God came to the city (m3). Japanese "訪れ" alone does not say who comes, so Literal supplies God in brackets, and Balanced and Readable say it plainly, as the English does.

source.text: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς πωλοῦντας, λέγων αὐτοῖς· Γέγραπται· Καὶ ἔσται ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς, ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ἐποιήσατε σπήλαιον λῃστῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And having entered into the temple he began to drive out the [ones] selling, \v 46 saying to them, It has been written, And will be the house of me a house of prayer, but you it made a cave of robbers.

en.L: And entering the temple, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to drive out those who were selling, \v 46 saying to them, "It is written, 'And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house shall be a house of prayer,' but you have made it a cave of robbers."
en.B: Then Jesus went into the temple and began to throw out the people who were selling there. \v 46 He said to them, "Scripture says, 'My house will be a house of prayer.' But you have turned it into a hideout for robbers."
en.R: Jesus went into the temple courts and began to force out the people who were selling things there. \v 46 He said to them, "The Scriptures say, 'My house will be a place where people pray.' But you have made it a hiding place for robbers!"

es.L: Y entrando en el templo, comenzó a echar fuera a los que vendían, \v 46 diciéndoles: «Está escrito: “Y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa será casa de oración”, pero {{plural_you:ustedes la han hecho|vosotros la habéis hecho}} cueva de bandidos».
es.B: Luego Jesús entró en el templo y comenzó a echar fuera a los que vendían allí. \v 46 Les dijo: «La Escritura dice: “Mi casa será casa de oración”. Pero {{plural_you:ustedes la han convertido|vosotros la habéis convertido}} en guarida de bandidos».
es.R: Jesús entró en los patios del templo y comenzó a sacar a la gente que estaba vendiendo cosas allí. \v 46 Les dijo: «La Escritura dice: “Mi casa será un lugar donde la gente ore”. ¡Pero {{plural_you:ustedes la han convertido|vosotros la habéis convertido}} en un escondite de bandidos!».

fr.L: Et, étant entré dans le temple, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se mit à chasser ceux qui vendaient, \v 46 leur disant : « Il est écrit : “Et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison sera une maison de prière”, mais vous, vous en avez fait une caverne de brigands. »
fr.B: Puis Jésus entra dans la cour du temple et se mit à chasser ceux qui y vendaient. \v 46 Il leur dit : « L’Écriture dit : “Ma maison sera une maison de prière.” Mais vous, vous en avez fait un repaire de bandits. »
fr.R: Jésus est entré dans la cour du temple. Il a commencé à mettre dehors les gens qui vendaient des choses à cet endroit. \v 46 Il leur a dit : « Les Écritures disent : “Ma maison sera un endroit où les gens prient.” Mais vous, vous en avez fait une cachette pour les voleurs ! »

sw.L: Na akiisha kuingia hekaluni, alianza kuwafukuza nje wale waliokuwa wakiuza, \v 46 akiwaambia, "Imeandikwa, 'Na nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakuwa nyumba ya maombi,' lakini ninyi mmeifanya pango la wanyang'anyi."
sw.B: Kisha Yesu aliingia hekaluni, akaanza kuwafukuza watu waliokuwa wakiuza humo. \v 46 Akawaambia, "Maandiko yanasema, 'Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakuwa nyumba ya maombi.' Lakini ninyi mmeigeuza kuwa maficho ya wanyang'anyi."
sw.R: Yesu aliingia katika nyua za hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza watu waliokuwa wakiuza vitu humo. \v 46 Akawaambia, "Maandiko yanasema, 'Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakuwa mahali ambapo watu wanaomba.' Lakini ninyi mmeigeuza kuwa mahali pa kujificha wanyang'anyi!"

vi.L: Và vào đền thờ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu đuổi những người bán ra, \v 46 nói với họ: "Có lời chép: 'Và nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là nhà cầu nguyện,' nhưng các người đã biến nó thành hang trộm cướp."
vi.B: Rồi Đức Giê-xu vào sân đền thờ và bắt đầu đuổi những người đang buôn bán ở đó ra. \v 46 Ngài nói với họ: "Kinh Thánh chép: 'Nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là nhà cầu nguyện.' Thế mà các người đã biến nó thành sào huyệt của bọn cướp."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu vào sân đền thờ và bắt đầu đuổi những người đang bán hàng ở đó ra ngoài. \v 46 Ngài nói với họ: "Kinh Thánh nói: 'Nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là nơi người ta đến cầu nguyện.' Nhưng các người đã biến nó thành nơi ẩn náu của bọn trộm cướp!"

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 성전에 들어가셔서 파는 사람들을 쫓아내기 시작하시며 \v 46 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "기록되어 있다. '그리고 내 집은 기도하는 집이 될 것이다.' 그런데 너희는 그것을 강도들의 소굴로 만들었다."
ko.B: 예수께서 성전 뜰에 들어가셔서 거기서 장사하는 사람들을 쫓아내기 시작하셨다. \v 46 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "성경에 '내 집은 기도하는 집이 될 것이다' 하고 기록되어 있다. 그런데 너희는 그곳을 강도들의 소굴로 만들어 버렸다."
ko.R: 예수께서 성전 뜰에 들어가셔서 거기서 물건을 파는 사람들을 내쫓기 시작하셨다. \v 46 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "성경에서 하나님께서 이렇게 말씀하셨다. '내 집은 사람들이 기도하는 곳이 될 것이다.' 그런데 너희는 이곳을 강도들이 숨는 곳으로 만들었다!"

pt.L: E, entrando no templo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} começou a expulsar os que vendiam, \v 46 dizendo-lhes: "Está escrito: 'E a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa será casa de oração', mas vocês fizeram dela um covil de ladrões."
pt.B: Então Jesus entrou no templo e começou a expulsar as pessoas que vendiam ali. \v 46 Ele lhes disse: "As Escrituras dizem: 'Minha casa será casa de oração.' Mas vocês fizeram dela um esconderijo de bandidos."
pt.R: Jesus entrou nos pátios do templo e começou a expulsar as pessoas que vendiam coisas ali. \v 46 Ele disse a elas: "As Escrituras dizem: 'Minha casa será um lugar onde as pessoas oram.' Mas vocês fizeram dela um lugar onde os bandidos se escondem!"

am.L: ወደ ቤተ መቅደስም ገብቶ የሚሸጡትን ያስወጣ ጀመር፤ \v 46 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ተጽፏል፦ “ቤቴም የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል”፤ እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ አደረጋችሁት።»
am.B: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ወደ ቤተ መቅደስ ገብቶ በዚያ የሚሸጡትን ሰዎች ያባርር ጀመር። \v 46 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ተጽፏል፦ “ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል።” እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች መደበቂያ አደረጋችሁት።»
am.R: ኢየሱስ ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ አደባባይ ገባ፤ በዚያ ዕቃ የሚሸጡትንም ሰዎች ያስወጣ ጀመር። \v 46 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «መጻሕፍት “ቤቴ ሰዎች የሚጸልዩበት ስፍራ ይሆናል” ይላሉ። እናንተ ግን ወንበዴዎች የሚደበቁበት ስፍራ አደረጋችሁት!»

ru.L: И, войдя в Храм, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} начал изгонять продающих, \v 46 говоря им: «Написано: “И дом {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} будет домом молитвы”, а вы сделали его пещерой разбойников.»
ru.B: Потом Иисус вошёл во двор Храма и начал выгонять тех, кто там продавал. \v 46 Он сказал им: «Написано: “Мой дом будет домом молитвы.” А вы превратили его в логово разбойников.»
ru.R: Иисус вошёл во двор Храма и начал выгонять людей, которые там что-то продавали. \v 46 Он сказал им: «В Писании сказано: “Мой дом будет местом, где люди молятся.” А вы сделали его местом, где прячутся разбойники!»

hi.L: और मन्दिर में प्रवेश करके वे बेचनेवालों को बाहर निकालने लगे, \v 46 और उनसे कहा, "लिखा है, 'और मेरा घर प्रार्थना का घर होगा,' पर तुमने उसे डाकुओं की खोह बना दिया है।"
hi.B: फिर यीशु मन्दिर में गए और वहाँ बेचनेवालों को बाहर खदेड़ने लगे। \v 46 उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "पवित्रशास्त्र में लिखा है, 'मेरा घर प्रार्थना का घर होगा।' पर तुमने उसे डाकुओं का अड्डा बना दिया है।"
hi.R: यीशु मन्दिर के आँगन में गए और वहाँ चीज़ें बेचनेवालों को बाहर निकालने लगे। \v 46 उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "पवित्रशास्त्र में लिखा है, 'मेरा घर ऐसी जगह होगा जहाँ लोग प्रार्थना करते हैं।' पर तुमने उसे ऐसी जगह बना दिया है जहाँ डाकू छिपते हैं!"

uk.L: І, увійшовши до храму, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} почав виганяти тих, що продавали, \v 46 кажучи їм: «Написано: “І буде дім {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} домом молитви”, а ви зробили його печерою розбійників.»
uk.B: Потім Ісус увійшов до храму й почав виганяти тих, хто там продавав. \v 46 Він сказав їм: «Написано: “Мій дім буде домом молитви.” А ви перетворили його на лігво розбійників.»
uk.R: Ісус увійшов на подвірʼя храму й почав виганяти людей, які там щось продавали. \v 46 Він сказав їм: «У Писанні сказано: “Мій дім буде місцем, де люди моляться.” А ви зробили з нього сховище для грабіжників!»

ja.L: そして神殿に入ると、[イエスは]売っている者たちを追い出し始め、\v 46 彼らに言われた。「『そして、わたしの家は祈りの家となる』と書かれている。だがあなたがたは、それを強盗たちの洞穴にしてしまった。」
ja.B: それからイエスは神殿の境内に入り、そこで物を売っていた人々を追い出し始めて、\v 46 彼らに言われた。「『わたしの家は祈りの家となる』と聖書に書いてある。それなのにあなたがたは、ここを盗賊の隠れ家にしてしまった。」
ja.R: イエスは神殿の境内に入られました。そして、そこで物を売っていた人たちを追い出し始められました。\v 46 イエスは彼らに言われました。「聖書に、『わたしの家は、人々が祈る家となる』と書いてある。それなのに、あなたたちはここを、強盗が隠れる場所にしてしまった！」

decisions.choice: the temple: the whole temple area with its outer courts, where animals for sacrifice were sold
decisions.reason: The word means the temple with its courts. Traders sold animals and birds for the sacrifices and changed money for the temple tax in the outer court.

decisions.choice: my house shall be a house of prayer: Isaiah 56:7
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 56:7 God promises that foreigners who hold fast to his covenant will be brought to his holy mountain, for his house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples. "My" is God speaking. Luke quotes the first part only.

decisions.choice: a cave of robbers: Jeremiah 7:11
decisions.reason: Jeremiah stood at the temple gate and asked whether the house called by God's name had become a robbers' cave in the people's eyes, because they sinned and then came to the temple as if it made them safe (Jeremiah 7:1-15). Robbers hide in caves between their raids. Jeremiah went on to warn that the temple would be destroyed.

decisions.choice: those who were selling: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: those who were selling in it and those who were buying, as in many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "in it, and those who were buying", which matches Mark 11:15. The shorter text has early support. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: robbers: bandits who take by force
decisions.reason: The word means a bandit or armed robber, as in 10:30.

decisions.choice: a cave of robbers (L); a hideout for robbers (B); a hiding place for robbers (R)
decisions.reason: "Den" is now used mostly of an animal's lair, and "thieves" is weaker than the word. The renderings say what a robbers' cave was for (m3).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} (L); My, capitalized either way at the start of the quotation (B, R)
decisions.reason: God is the speaker in Isaiah 56:7.

decisions.choice: a place where people pray
decisions.reason: Readable says what the phrase means.

decisions.choice: temple courts
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the selling was in the courts (m1).

decisions.choice: bandidos
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a robber who uses violence, a bandit (meaning decision m5), not a sneak thief; "ladrones" usually means thieves. As in Matthew 21:13.

decisions.choice: Está escrito (L); La Escritura dice (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula used through the Gospels, following the English "It is written" (L) and "Scripture says" (B, R).

decisions.choice: le temple (L); la cour du temple (B, R) (for the whole chapter)
alternatives: le temple at every level, as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: As the style guide settles for this word and as Luke 2 and Mark 11 have it: the selling and the teaching took place in the open courts, not in the sanctuary (m1). The English Balanced keeps "temple"; French Balanced follows the term sheet, as the English Readable says "temple courts".

decisions.choice: une caverne de brigands (L); un repaire de bandits (B); une cachette pour les voleurs (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:17: the word means bandits who take by force (m5), stronger than "voleurs"; Readable uses the common word and says what the cave was for.

decisions.choice: Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, with a span at every level
alternatives: yangu with no span, as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The English "My" opens the quotation in Balanced and Readable and is capitalised anyway, so it has no span there (decision r-en-2). Swahili puts the possessive after the noun, where it can take the setting, as in Matthew 21:13.

decisions.choice: wanyang'anyi
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a robber who uses violence, a bandit (meaning decision m5), not a thief ("mwizi"). "Wanyang'anyi" is the term the shared term sheet sets for this word, as in John 18:40.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" (L); "sân đền thờ" (B, R) for the temple area (also 19:47)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:15: the selling was in the outer courts (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}" at every level
decisions.reason: God speaks in Isaiah 56:7; in Vietnamese the pronoun follows the noun, so it is never sentence-initial and keeps its span at every level, as in Mark 11:17.

decisions.choice: "hang trộm cướp" (L); "sào huyệt của bọn cướp" (B); "nơi ẩn náu của bọn trộm cướp" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:17.

decisions.choice: "성전" (L); "성전 뜰" (B, R) for hieron, through Luke 19-21
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 2:27 and Mark 11:11: hieron is the whole temple area.

decisions.choice: "쫓아내다" (L, B), "내쫓다" (R); "강도들의 소굴" (L, B), "강도들이 숨는 곳" (R); "내 집" with no span
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Mark 11:15-17 and Matthew 21:12-13.

decisions.choice: um covil de ladrões (L); um esconderijo de bandidos (B); um lugar onde os bandidos se escondem (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Mark 11:17 in Portuguese, since the Greek is the same. "Covil" is the lair where robbers hide between raids (m3); Balanced and Readable say "bandidos", the stronger word (m5).

decisions.choice: "ይሆናል" (shall be)
decisions.reason: Matthew's Greek says the house "will be called" a house of prayer; Luke's says it "will be" one, so the Amharic differs where the Greek does, and keeps Matthew's wording elsewhere ("ተጽፏል", "የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ").

decisions.choice: "изгонять" (L), "выгонять" (B, R); "пещера разбойников" (L), "логово разбойников" (B), "место, где прячутся разбойники" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of Mark 11:15-17 at each level, where the Greek is the same; the Synodal "вертеп" is now a word for a den of vice.

decisions.choice: "डाकुओं की खोह" (L); "डाकुओं का अड्डा" (B); "जहाँ डाकू छिपते हैं" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:17, where the Greek is the same: the word is for bandits who take by force (meaning decision m5), not thieves. God's words "मेरा घर" take no setting in Hindi.

decisions.choice: "розбійники" (L, B); "грабіжники" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled terms for *lēstai*, bandits who take by force; "злодії" would mean thieves who steal in secret.

decisions.choice: "強盗たちの洞穴" (L); "盗賊の隠れ家" (B); "強盗が隠れる場所" (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in Mark 11:17, kept as Mark's Japanese has them. A robbers' cave is where bandits hide between raids (m3, m5); Literal keeps the cave, and Balanced and Readable say what it was for.

decisions.choice: "神殿" (L); "神殿の境内" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means the temple with its courts, where the selling went on (m1); as in Mark 11:15 and the Gospels' shared terms.

source.text: Καὶ ἦν διδάσκων τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ· οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἀπολέσαι καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ οὐχ εὕρισκον τὸ τί ποιήσωσιν, ὁ λαὸς γὰρ ἅπας ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ ἀκούων.

records.literal_gloss: And he was teaching day by day in the temple; but the chief priests and the scribes were seeking him to destroy and the leading [men] of the people, \v 48 and not they were finding what they might do, the people for all were hanging on him listening.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes were seeking to destroy {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and [so were] the leading men of the people, \v 48 and they did not find what they might do, for all the people were hanging on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, listening.
en.B: Every day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} taught in the temple. The chief priests and the scribes wanted to kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and so did the leaders of the people. \v 48 But they could find no way to do it, because all the people clung to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, listening to every word.
en.R: Every day Jesus taught in the temple courts. The chief priests and the teachers of the law wanted to kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. The other leaders of the people wanted this too. \v 48 But they could not find a way to do it, because all the people were listening closely to everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said.

es.L: Y enseñaba cada día en el templo. Pero los principales sacerdotes y los escribas procuraban acabar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y [también] los principales del pueblo; \v 48 y no hallaban qué hacer, porque todo el pueblo estaba pendiente de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, escuchándolo.
es.B: Todos los días enseñaba en el templo. Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los escribas querían matarlo, y también los dirigentes del pueblo. \v 48 Pero no encontraban la manera de hacerlo, porque todo el pueblo estaba pendiente de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, sin perder palabra.
es.R: Jesús enseñaba todos los días en los patios del templo. Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los maestros de la ley querían matarlo. Los otros líderes del pueblo querían lo mismo. \v 48 Pero no encontraban la manera de hacerlo, porque toda la gente escuchaba con mucha atención todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} decía.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait chaque jour dans le temple. Mais les chefs des prêtres et les scribes cherchaient à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire périr, et [aussi] les premiers du peuple ; \v 48 et ils ne trouvaient pas ce qu’ils pourraient faire, car tout le peuple, en {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écoutant, était suspendu à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lèvres.
fr.B: Chaque jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait dans la cour du temple. Les chefs des prêtres et les scribes voulaient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire mourir, et les notables du peuple aussi. \v 48 Mais ils ne trouvaient pas comment s’y prendre, car le peuple tout entier était suspendu à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lèvres.
fr.R: Chaque jour, Jésus enseignait dans la cour du temple. Les chefs des prêtres et les spécialistes de la Loi voulaient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tuer. Les autres chefs du peuple le voulaient aussi. \v 48 Mais ils ne trouvaient pas le moyen de le faire, parce que tout le peuple écoutait avec attention tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akifundisha kila siku hekaluni. Lakini wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi walikuwa wakitafuta kumwangamiza, na [vivyo hivyo] wakuu wa watu, \v 48 wala hawakuona la kufanya, kwa maana watu wote walikuwa wakimng'ang'ania, wakimsikiliza.
sw.B: Kila siku alikuwa akifundisha hekaluni. Wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi walitaka kumwua, na viongozi wa watu vilevile. \v 48 Lakini hawakupata njia ya kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu watu wote walishikamana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, wakisikiliza kila neno.
sw.R: Kila siku Yesu alifundisha katika nyua za hekalu. Wakuu wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walitaka kumwua. Viongozi wengine wa watu nao walitaka hivyo. \v 48 Lakini hawakupata njia ya kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu watu wote walikuwa wakisikiliza kwa makini kila kitu alichosema.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy dỗ hằng ngày trong đền thờ; nhưng các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo tìm cách giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và những người đứng đầu dân chúng [cũng vậy], \v 48 nhưng họ không tìm ra được điều gì họ có thể làm, vì toàn dân đều bám lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà nghe.
vi.B: Hằng ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giảng dạy trong sân đền thờ. Các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo tìm cách giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và các nhà lãnh đạo của dân chúng cũng vậy. \v 48 Nhưng họ không tìm được cách nào, vì cả dân chúng đều chăm chú nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không bỏ sót một lời.
vi.R: Ngày nào Đức Giê-xu cũng giảng dạy trong sân đền thờ. Các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy dạy luật muốn giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Các nhà lãnh đạo khác của dân chúng cũng muốn như vậy. \v 48 Nhưng họ không tìm ra cách nào để làm việc đó, vì tất cả dân chúng đều chăm chú lắng nghe mọi lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 날마다 성전에서 가르치고 계셨다. 그런데 대제사장들과 율법학자들이 그분을 없애려고 찾고 있었고, 백성의 지도자들도 [그러하였다]. \v 48 그러나 그들은 무엇을 해야 할지 찾지 못하였다. 온 백성이 그분께 매달려 [말씀을] 듣고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 날마다 성전 뜰에서 가르치셨다. 대제사장들과 율법학자들과 백성의 지도자들은 예수를 죽이려고 했다. \v 48 그러나 그들은 어떻게 해야 할지 방법을 찾지 못했다. 온 백성이 예수 곁을 떠나지 않고 그분의 말씀을 하나하나 귀담아듣고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 날마다 성전 뜰에서 가르치셨다. 대제사장들과 율법을 가르치는 선생들이 예수를 죽이려고 했다. 백성의 다른 지도자들도 그렇게 하려고 했다. \v 48 그러나 그들은 그렇게 할 방법을 찾지 못했다. 모든 사람이 예수의 말씀을 하나도 놓치지 않으려고 귀 기울여 듣고 있었기 때문이다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ensinava diariamente no templo. Mas os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas procuravam destruí-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}, e [também] os principais do povo, \v 48 e não encontravam o que poderiam fazer, pois todo o povo estava preso a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, ouvindo[-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}].
pt.B: Jesus ensinava todos os dias no templo. Os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas queriam matá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}, e os líderes do povo também. \v 48 Mas não achavam um jeito de fazer isso, porque todo o povo estava preso a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, atento a cada palavra.
pt.R: Jesus ensinava todos os dias nos pátios do templo. Os chefes dos sacerdotes e os mestres da Lei queriam matar Jesus. Os outros líderes do povo também queriam isso. \v 48 Mas eles não conseguiam encontrar um jeito de fazer isso, porque todo o povo ouvia com muita atenção tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dizia.

am.L: በየቀኑም በቤተ መቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፤ የካህናት አለቆችና ጸሐፍት ግን፣ የሕዝቡ ታላላቆችም [ጭምር]፣ ሊያጠፉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ \v 48 የሚያደርጉትንም አላገኙም፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እየሰማው በእርሱ ላይ ተንጠልጥሎ ነበርና።
am.B: በየቀኑ በቤተ መቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር። የካህናት አለቆችና የሕግ መምህራን፣ የሕዝቡ መሪዎችም ጭምር ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር። \v 48 ነገር ግን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቃሉን በጉጉት ይሰሙ ስለ ነበረ ይህን የሚያደርጉበት መንገድ አላገኙም።
am.R: ኢየሱስ በየቀኑ በቤተ መቅደሱ አደባባይ ያስተምር ነበር። የካህናት አለቆችና የሕግ መምህራን ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር። ሌሎቹ የሕዝቡ መሪዎችም ይህንኑ ይፈልጉ ነበር። \v 48 ነገር ግን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እርሱ የሚናገረውን ሁሉ በጥንቃቄ ያዳምጡ ስለ ነበረ ሊገድሉት የሚችሉበትን መንገድ አላገኙም።

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} учил каждый день в Храме. А старшие священники и книжники искали погубить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и первые [люди] народа, \v 48 и не находили, что бы сделать, потому что весь народ, слушая, не отходил от {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.B: Каждый день {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} учил в Храме. Старшие священники и учители Закона хотели убить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и того же хотели вожди народа. \v 48 Но они не находили способа это сделать, потому что весь народ не отходил от {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} и ловил каждое {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слово.
ru.R: Каждый день Иисус учил во дворе Храма. Старшие священники и учители Закона хотели убить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Другие вожди народа тоже этого хотели. \v 48 Но они не могли найти способа это сделать, потому что все люди внимательно слушали всё, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорил.

hi.L: और वे प्रतिदिन मन्दिर में उपदेश देते थे; पर प्रधान याजक और शास्त्री उन्हें नाश करने की ताक में थे, और प्रजा के प्रमुख [भी], \v 48 पर उन्हें न सूझा कि क्या करें, क्योंकि सब लोग उनसे लिपटे हुए उनकी सुनते थे।
hi.B: वे हर दिन मन्दिर में उपदेश देते थे। प्रधान याजक और व्यवस्था के शिक्षक उन्हें मार डालना चाहते थे, और लोगों के अगुवे भी। \v 48 पर उन्हें ऐसा करने का कोई रास्ता न मिला, क्योंकि सब लोग उनसे लगे रहते थे और उनकी एक-एक बात सुनते थे।
hi.R: यीशु हर दिन मन्दिर के आँगन में उपदेश देते थे। प्रधान याजक और व्यवस्था के शिक्षक उन्हें मार डालना चाहते थे। लोगों के दूसरे अगुवे भी यही चाहते थे। \v 48 पर उन्हें ऐसा करने का कोई रास्ता नहीं मिला, क्योंकि सब लोग उनकी हर बात बड़े ध्यान से सुन रहे थे।

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} навчав щодня в храмі. А старші священники й книжники шукали, як {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} погубити, і [так само] провідники народу, \v 48 і не знаходили, що б зробити, бо весь народ тримався {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, слухаючи.
uk.B: Щодня {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} навчав у храмі. Старші священники та вчителі Закону хотіли {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вбити, і так само провідники народу. \v 48 Але вони не знаходили способу це зробити, бо весь народ горнувся до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} й ловив кожне {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слово.
uk.R: Щодня Ісус навчав на подвірʼї храму. Старші священники й учителі Закону хотіли {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вбити. Інші провідники народу теж цього хотіли. \v 48 Але вони не могли знайти способу це зробити, бо всі люди уважно слухали все, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} казав.

ja.L: そして[イエスは]毎日、神殿で教えておられた。しかし祭司長たちと律法学者たちは、イエスを滅ぼそうと探しており、民の主だった者たちも[同じであった]。\v 48 しかし、何をしたらよいか見つけられなかった。民が皆、イエスにすがりつくようにして聞き入っていたからである。
ja.B: イエスは毎日、神殿の境内で教えておられた。祭司長たちと律法学者たち、それに民の指導者たちは、イエスを殺そうとねらっていた。\v 48 しかし、どうすることもできなかった。民が皆、イエスから離れず、その一言一言に聞き入っていたからである。
ja.R: イエスは毎日、神殿の境内で教えておられました。祭司長たちと律法の先生たちは、イエスを殺したいと思っていました。民のほかの指導者たちも同じでした。\v 48 けれども、どうすればよいのか、わかりませんでした。人々がみな、イエスの話すことを一言ももらさずに、熱心に聞いていたからです。

decisions.choice: the chief priests, the scribes, the leading men of the people: the groups that made up the ruling council
decisions.reason: The senior priests, the experts in the law and the leading laymen of Jerusalem formed the council that would hand Jesus over (9:22; 22:66). Jesus had foretold that these men would reject him.

decisions.choice: were hanging on him, listening: listened eagerly, holding on to every word
decisions.reason: The verb pictures someone hanging from a support. The people held on to Jesus' words, and their support kept the leaders from acting openly.

decisions.choice: destroy: put to death
decisions.reason: The verb is used for killing (6:9; 17:27).

decisions.choice: was teaching day by day: his regular practice during these days
decisions.reason: Luke describes Jesus' daily teaching in the temple (21:37-38; 22:53).

decisions.choice: the chief priests and the teachers of the law (R); the chief priests and the scribes (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 9:22: "scribes" today suggests people who copy documents, so Readable says what these men did.

decisions.choice: clung to him, listening to every word
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of holding on (m2) in plainer words.

decisions.choice: los principales sacerdotes (L), los jefes de los sacerdotes (B, R); los escribas (L, B), los maestros de la ley (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used through the Gospels. Readable says what the scribes were, teachers of the law, as the English Readable does (decision r-en-1). Literal keeps the traditional title for the chief priests, as Mark and John do; Balanced and Readable say plainly that they were the heads of the priesthood.

decisions.choice: les chefs des prêtres (every level); les scribes (L, B), les spécialistes de la Loi (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, as in Mark 11:18. "Les grands prêtres" would blur the line with "le grand prêtre" himself; Readable follows the English "teachers of the law".

decisions.choice: était suspendu à ses lèvres (L, B)
decisions.reason: French has an idiom with the same picture as the Greek "hanging on him" (m2), "être suspendu aux lèvres de quelqu’un", so Literal and Balanced can keep the image; a word-for-word "suspendu à lui" would not be understood. Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa makuhani; waandishi (L, B), walimu wa sheria (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used through the Gospels. Readable says what the scribes were, teachers of the law, as the English Readable does (decision r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "các thầy tế lễ cả" at every level; "các thầy thông giáo" (L, B), "các thầy dạy luật" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled forms for the Gospels, as in Mark 11:18.

decisions.choice: "những người đứng đầu dân chúng" (L); "các nhà lãnh đạo của dân chúng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Leading laymen of the ruling council (meaning decision), named without a technical title.

decisions.choice: "bám lấy Ngài mà nghe" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of hanging on him (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "대제사장들"; "율법학자들" (L, B), "율법을 가르치는 선생들" (R); "백성의 지도자들" at every level, through Luke 19-21
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 9:22 and 11:53 and Mark 11:18.

decisions.choice: "매달려 듣다" (L); "곁을 떠나지 않고 ... 귀담아듣다" (B); "하나도 놓치지 않으려고 귀 기울여 듣다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek pictures the people hanging on him as they listened (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: [그러하였다], [말씀을]
decisions.reason: Korean needs a verb for the third group and an object for "listening".

decisions.choice: estava preso a ele
decisions.reason: "Pendurado" would be taken literally in Portuguese. "Estar preso a" keeps the picture of holding on (m2) in a phrase Brazilians use of attention ("preso à história").

decisions.choice: "ጸሐፍት" (L); "የሕግ መምህራን" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The scribes were teachers of the Law, not copyists; Literal keeps the traditional word, and Balanced and Readable say what they were.

decisions.choice: "старшие священники"; "книжники" (L), "учители Закона" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's book-wide terms: the Synodal plural "первосвященники" blurs the one high priest with the leading priests.

decisions.choice: "शास्त्री" (L); "व्यवस्था के शिक्षक" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The scribes were teachers of the Law, not copyists; Balanced and Readable say what they did, as the style guide has it. The chief priests are "प्रधान याजक".

decisions.choice: "старші священники"
decisions.reason: The settled term: the plural "первосвященики" would blur the one high priest with the leading priests.

decisions.choice: "すがりつくようにして聞き入っていた" (L); "イエスから離れず、その一言一言に聞き入っていた" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures hanging from a support (m2). Literal keeps a picture of holding on; Balanced says it in plainer words, as the English Balanced does.
